name: Api
description:
This Api restores a few lost Health Points.
Placed on a friend's head, it makes an excellent target. The Api, we mean.

name: Superior Health Flask
description: This flask restores some Health Points.

name: Health Flask
description: This flask restores some Health Points.

name: Amakna Beer
description: As the old paternal saying goes: "Sometimes you drink your drink and sometimes your drink drinks you."

name: Incarnam Bread
description: Soft of texture, golden of crust and hot out of the oven, this small loaf will increase your Health Points. It's the most popular type of bread and usually the cheapest.

name: Borodinsky
description: This bread is one of the trickiest to make... It's extremely difficult to remain coherent as the fumes make their inebriating way into your bloodstream and your loaves slowly begin to scream terrifyingly cruel obscenities at you.

name: Sesame Seed Bread
description: The most daring Kwaks often dress up as bakers to steal crumbs of sesame seed bread with impunity. After a long process of trial and costly error, Kwaks now know to only try this trick on Iop bakers.

name: Crispbread
description: This bread is rich in protein but completely tasteless. That's just the way it is - you can't have your bread and eat it too, as the bakers say.

name: Fougasse
description: This bread, cooked to golden perfection with a delicate flour contains no colourings or preservatives, unlike the Royal Jelly.

name: Cereal Bread
description: This multi-cereal bread contains enough fibre to give a dead man the runs.

name: Mantou
description: This crustless bread is quite popular with Enutrofs who've lost their dentures.

name: Carasau
description: This bread is enriched with whole Barley, which makes for a quality product.

name: Rolled Oat Bread
description: This bread, light and soft in the centre, is ideal for people that Single Mother Nature has endowed with a tiny stomach...

name: Rye Bread
description: This bread is prepared with Rye Flour, which lends a brown colour to the centre and a delicious, sugary flavour.

name: Recall Potion
description: This potion will take you back to your last save point.

name: Ghetto Raid Potion
description: This potion lets you recover energy points.

name: Pouch of Kolossokens
description: Use this pouch to earn 1,000 kolossokens.

Be careful though, as you can only use it if your intelligence is below 25.

name: Solid Bread
description: Made with Hop, this bread is fatty with a brown centre. Although rich in essential oils, it tastes awful.

name: Golden Brioche
description: The recipe for this brioche was standardised by Xavier the Baker himself. He wanted to make a delicious and light brioche. It's more than he could have hoped for...

name: Curryless Curry Bread
description: A Kwaker Vans prototype. Its flavour and quality are surprising, but so is the smell, unfortunately. You'll never get used to it.

name: Expired Potion
description:
This potion is expired, but with luck, it might be possible to recover the resources used to make it.

name: Lemon Shigekax
description: Rediscover the charm and flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made lemon-flavoured candy.

name: Strawberry Shigekax
description: Rediscover the charm and flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made strawberry-flavoured candy.

name: Mint Shigekax
description: Rediscover the charm and flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made mint-flavoured candy.

name: Cherry Shigekax
description: Rediscover the charm and flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made cherry-flavoured candy.

name: Greenjely
description: Despite repulsing more than a few vegetarians, this minty jelly treat is still an Amaknian favourite.

name: Redjely
description: Despite repulsing more than a few vegetarians, this strawberry jelly treat is still an Amaknian favourite.

name: Blujely
description: Despite repulsing more than a few vegetarians, this blue jelly treat is still an Amaknian favourite.

name: Multijely
description: Multijely was banned after children started disappearing soon after eating it. Not long after, they realised the kids were just going to the shop to get more.

name: Mini Healing Potion
description: This mini potion will make you feel a little better.

name: Superior Mini Healing Potion
description: This mini potion will make you feel a little better than better.

name: Fairy Water
description: The fairy water has healing properties similar to those of Eniripsa's blood. No more need to bleed the poor fellows dry.

name: Unikron Blood
description: This potion faithfully reproduces all the properties of Unikron blood, except immortality. Drink it and you'll be cured!

name: The Legend of Crocoburio
description: This book relates the story of the notorious Crocoburio.

name: The Treechnid Forest
description: This book tells the legend of the Treechnid Forest.

name: Creating Magic Items for Ninnies
description: This book is full of advice for novice Mages. Essential reading.

name: Transport Rune
description: (This item apparently contains no magic whatsoever)

name: The Legend of the Cruncher
description: This book relates the journey of the last Human who got to meet the Cruncher.

name: Emote Scroll: Break Wind
description: Use this scroll to learn the Break Wind emote. Use it in moderation as it can be dangerous for you and your friends. Your enemies will want to steer clear of getting in the path of this lethal stuff.

name: Dantegoulish Potion
description: This magic potion is the only one that can cast magic into the lattice-work leather panties of Captain Chafer...It speaks volumes about the power of such a potion.

name: Pahoa Raid Potion
description: This potion lets you recover energy points.

name: Raid Boole Potion
description: This potion lets you recover energy points.

name: The Kwismas Gift
description: Christmas Bestseller 634. This is essential reading. It's a classic!

name: The Fromsky Family
description: Second best seller of the winter of 634, this book is already a reference.

name: First Christmas
description: The odds-on outsider for the beginning of 635, this book has gained a cult following in recent months.

name: Field Bread
description: This Field Bread feels like a stone in your pocket... and in your belly for that matter. But it has that familiar rustic flavour that any good bread should have.

name: City Bread
description: This bread will give you the appetite of a bulimic giant. It'll also fill you very, very quickly. These conflicting properties have killed thousands. Don't be next.

name: Phoenix Blood
description: This phoenix blood can revive a ghost and pep it up with 5,000 energy points.

name: Great Phoenix Blood
description: This phoenix blood can revive a ghost and pep it up with 10,000 energy points.

name: Fried Breaded Fish
description: This rectangle is made from fat-free pieces of cubic fish. Its bland taste delights children but it has low nutritional value.

name: Fried Igloo Fish
description: This incredibly tasty stick is made from the best fat-free pieces of cubic fish. Its taste delights children and it has excellent nutritional value.

name: Crab Stick
description: Enjoy it everywhere, but be careful not to eat too much...

name: Exotic Crab Stick
description: Made from Exotic Crab Surimi, this meat tastes disgusting, but is very nutritious.

name: Smoked Kittenfish
description: Delicately smoked, this Kittenfish makes a marvellous meal. But be careful, as its smell will stick to your clothes for several decades.

name: Smoked Tigerfish
description: Firmer and more refined than Smoked Kittenfish, this Smoked Tigerfish will delight lovers of fine cuisine.

name: Grilled Bass
description: Served on top of lettuce, this fish will fill your belly for a little while. It's not the tastiest, though.

name: Grawn Fritters
description: Everybody likes crunchy Grawn Fritters. The problem is that they quickly become addictive.

name: Sliced Gudgeon
description: Slices of gudgeon, hard boiled with onions. Quite delightful despite the smell off you for the following few days.

name: Ray Wing
description: When cooked too quickly in black Bwork butter, this wing releases an eye-watering flavour into the chewing mouth of the muncher. This meal is not a memorable one.

name: Small Steamed Carp
description: Steam-cooked to retain the flavour, this small carp's flavour will sweep you off your feet!

name: Steamed Carp
description: Steam-cooked to retain the flavour, this small carp will make you forget all your troubles. Tomorrow's gonna be another day... just enjoy this steamed-carp-flavoured moment!

name: Grilled Kralove
description:
This Grilled Kralove gives off a strong smell, but it's a true delicacy if you manage to overcome your disgust. 
A small piece of advice... find something long and sharp to eat it with.

name: Sautéed Perch
description: This fish swam a long way, but failed to make it to the spawning grounds. Still, it's ready to be eaten, even if it is a little bland.

name: Sautéed Kittenperch
description: This fish swam a long way, and spawned many young in the rivers of Amakna. It's now ready to be eaten, and tastes delicious.

name: Smothered Sardine
description: You won't feed the family, or even yourself, with this sardine, but it does make an excellent starter. That said, don't eat it on Tholank's feast day – choking is all but guaranteed then.

name: Smothered Dark Sardine
description: You won't feed the family, or even yourself, with this sardine, but it does make an excellent dessert.

name: Grilled Siktrin Bass
description: Served on top of lettuce, this fish will fill your belly for a long time. It's absolutely delicious!

name: Horror Grawn Fritters
description: Everybody likes crunchy Grawn Fritters. With a low calorie content, it would stupid to refuse them.

name: Sliced Kiye Gudgeon
description: Slices of gudgeon, hard boiled with onions. Quite delightful... And the usual horrible odour is masked by a mysterious scent of fresh flowers too.

name: Farle's Ray Wing
description: When cooked with care in black Bwork butter, this Farle's Ray Wing releases an incredible flavour into the chewing mouth of the muncher. This meal will truly give you wings.

name: Trout Flambé
description: If prepared following the exotic and ancestral recipe of the Lenalds, this kind of fish will help rekindle the fire in your belly... provided you can master the recipe, which is very rare indeed.

name: Ancestral Trout Flambé
description: If prepared following the exotic and ancestral recipe of the Lenalds, this kind of fish will help rekindle the fire in your belly... provided you can master the recipe, which is very rare indeed.

name: Stuffed Pike
description: Ah, Stuffed Pike. Everyone eats it, but no one knows what's in it. And not trying to find out is a mark of wisdom.

name: Stuffed Tupe-Halett Pike
description: Ah, Stuffed Pike. Everyone eats it, but no one knows what's in it. And not trying to find out is a mark of wisdom.

name: Shark Fin
description: This shark wouldn't have the decency to sprinkle you with a few spices before it ate you.

name: Open-Market Shark Fin
description: This shark wouldn't have the decency to sprinkle you with a few magic spices before it ate you.

name: Grilled Unique Kralove
description: This Grilled Unique Kralove smells delicious. A cold Kikim Inn Beer, sunshine glinting off the Asse sea, a plateful of Grilled Unique Kralove. Does life get any better than that?

name: Feubuk Beer
description: This highly alcoholic beer will warm you up just as much as a roaring fireplace.

name: Tofu Fritters
description: These little pieces of fried bird are a delight to the taste buds. When they reach your stomach, it's a different story altogether.

name: Sautéed Kwak
description: These little pieces of fried bird are a delight to the taste buds. When they reach your stomach, it's a different story altogether.

name: Piwi Salmis
description: There's just enough meat for a bite.

name: Salted Larva
description: Dip the larva into boiling water for a good minute, this will firm up its gummy flesh. Then, sprinkle with salt and you'll have the ideal snack for a picnic.

name: Salted Precious Larva
description: Dip the larva into boiling water for a good minute, this will firm up its gummy flesh. Then, sprinkle with salt and you'll have the ideal snack for a picnic.

name: Insect Croquette
description: This appetizer is a real delight. Once you've tasted it, you'll find it hard to concentrate without having a nibble.

name: Scaraleaf Ball
description: This appetizer is a real delight. Once you've tasted it, you'll find it hard to concentrate without having a nibble.

name: Plant Soup
description: It's well known: children hate soup. If you want our advice, before serving this soup, make them lay down on the table, strap them down, and put a funnel in their mouths – it will make things much easier.

name: Rat Jowl Chunks
description: Like a Gobball, roasting a Rat is the only way to remove its bad smell. As a result, the delicate smell from this firm Rat Jowl will have you salivating instead of running away.

name: Roast Gobball Leg
description: Roasting a Gobball is the only way to remove its bad smell. As a result, the delicate smell from this firm Gobball War Chief leg will have you salivating instead of running away.

name: Roast Royal Gobball Leg
description: Roasting a Gobball is the only way to remove its bad smell. As a result, the delicate smell from this firm Royal Gobball leg will have you salivating instead of running away.

name: Dragomeat Steak
description: Some say a smile is worth a good meal... but a Dragomeat steak and chips? Not on your life!

name: Dragoemeat Steak
description: Some say a smile is worth a good meal... but a Dragoemeat steak and chips? Not on your life!

name: Dragosmeat Steak
description: Some say a smile is worth a good meal... but a Dragosmeat steak and chips? Not on your life!

name: Crocabulia Steak
description: Some say a smile is worth a good meal... but a Crocabulia steak and chips? Not on your life!

name: Gwilled Wabbit
description: Anyone who has tucked into a gwilled Wabbit steak will be familiar with the twinge of pity that accompanies every bite. As they say, 'It is the heartless who eat most heartily.'

name: Smoked Wabbit Jowl
description: Anyone who has tucked into a Smoked Wabbit Jowl will be familiar with the twinge of pity that accompanies every bite. As they say, 'It is the heartless who eat most heartily.'

name: Gwilled Wabbit Leg
description: Anyone who has tucked into a gwilled Wabbit steak will be familiar with the twinge of pity that accompanies every bite. As they say, 'It is the heartless who eat most heartily.'

name: Gwilled Wa Wabbit
description: Anyone who has tucked into a gwilled Wabbit steak will be familiar with the twinge of pity that accompanies every bite. As they say, 'It is the heartless who eat most heartily.'

name: Goblin Andouillette
description: It's both cheap meat and an insult.

name: Cooked Ham
description: Considered to be the most delicious cut of pig meat, Cooked Ham can be eaten... just for the sake of it...

name: Pork Roast
description: You secretly wish you could make your old mentor suffer the same fate for the years of humiliation he put you through.

name: Dragon Pig Roast
description: You don't feel any remorse about turning the Dragon Pig into a common roast. You'd consider it more or less the natural order of things.

name: Grilled Sirloin Tip
description: The traditional recipe consists of grilling this meat in burning sand, but since not everyone has burning sand handy, you can just throw it in the oven. Also, that keeps you from having to wash the meat after cooking it.

name: Boowolf Muzzle Vinaigrette
description: This salad won't leave you cold. Its unequalled flavour will have you rolling on the floor, crying with pleasure.

name: Moowolf Muzzle Vinaigrette
description: This salad won't leave you cold. Its unequalled flavour will have you rolling on the floor, crying with pleasure.

name: Sautéed Kwakwa
description: These little pieces of fried bird are a delight to the taste buds. When they reach your stomach, it's a different story altogether.

name: Golden Bread
description: This bread has been kneaded with Golden Wheat Flour. Selling it is a good way to get rich...

name: Briochette
description: This small brioche is made from Hops. This explains the huge surge of energy which overcomes you when you eat it.

name: Magic Briochette
description: This small brioche is made with Bright Hop Flour. This explains the huge surge of energy which overcomes you when you eat it.

name: Crakot
description: This type of Bread is made with Storm Flax Flour, which gives it a pleasant lightness and a great taste.

name: Resistant Rye Bread
description: This bread is prepared with Resistant Rye Flour, which gives it an awful flavour but lends it unique nutritional qualities.

name: Candy Cane
description: By extracting sugar from sweet barley flour, we obtain this unique magic-flavoured sweetie.

name: Gold-Bearing Rolled Oat Bread
description: This bread with an uber-soft centre is just perfect.

name: Burnt Cat Inn Beer
description: This beer looks a little bit too much like Bow Meow pee. Actually, having tasted it, maybe not enough.

name: Camouflaging Scroll
description: Thanks to this scroll you'll be able to camouflage yourself in the surrounding environment until your next fight. Avoid moving and making strange noises if you don't want to be found.

name: Kikim Inn Beer
description: Emptying several tankards of this salty beer can have side effects such as telling iffy jokes, starting fights, or retching all over the people sitting next to you. It's therefore best to consume it in moderation if you want to keep a clear head and fresh breath. That said, if your idea of a good time is a general brawl, your best bet will be to buy a round for everyone.

name: Atyu Sirvis Inn Beer
description: This Morello Cherry Blop-flavoured beer is sometimes called Manoca.

name: Bagrutte Inn Beer
description: This beer makes you more momentarily more valiant, but be careful. The higher you fly, the farther you fall!

name: Woodenglass Inn Beer
description: This is a classic beer and it comes in a wonderfully carved tankard. One of the few cases where the container has more value than the content (alongside Iop skulls and the popular press).

name: Pinchaut Beer
description: This beer is hot which makes it hard to drink in summer. On the other hand, it gives off a pleasant smell of toast, thus making it the ideal beer to drink at breakfast when there's no bread.

name: Scrapmetal Beer
description: This beer tastes of old iron, which is both unpleasant and revitalising.

name: Rasputin Cake
description: This cake is delicious, but it can be a bit hard to digest, especially when you add a touch of Scurvion seed.

name: Scroll of Bravery
description: This parchment increases your Strength. It can be useful when a furious Kaniger charges you.

name: Disheartening Scroll
description: Use this scroll to reduce the Strength of a single target. This can be useful when a furious Kaniger is charging your enemy.

name: Scroll of Suppleness
description: This scroll increases your Agility. It can be useful for dodging the Moowolf.

name: Scroll of Stiffness
description: This scroll reduces the Agility of a single target. Use it to prevent your enemy from escaping a Moowolf attack.

name: Secrets of the Squirrel Language
description: This dictionary will teach you how to talk with squirrels, or at least how to try...

name: Investigation Form 36
description: This form is a good way to identify potential suspects of criminal actions.

name: Investigation Form 33
description:
This form is usually used to make suspects confess their criminal acts. All you have to do now is fill in a fake interview of Oni Tnec.
(Use it on yourself to use it)

name: Divorce Force
description: These rings can break the sacred bond of marriage.

name: Scroll of Knowledge
description: This parchment increases your Intelligence. It will help you keep your cool when faced with multiple enemies.

name: Scroll of Stupidity
description: This parchment reduces the Intelligence of a single target. It can be useful to prevent your enemy from moving when faced with a mob of angry Bworks.

name: Scroll of Restraint
description: This scroll increases your Wisdom, which is essential when confronting Dark Vlad.

name: Scroll of Senility
description: This parchment reduces the Wisdom of a single target. It's necessary when your enemy tries to equal Dark Vlad.

name: Scroll of Godsend
description: This parchment increases your Luck. Will you be lucky enough to find a Tofu in a haystack?

name: Scroll of Rotten Luck
description: This parchment can reduce the Chance of a single target, which is useful when, for example, your opponent's from the Emerald Isle.

name: Small Red Fairywork
description: Ideal for small weddings, and perfect for the annual Captain Chafer Panty Party.

name: Blood Sniffling Staff
description: This staff is possessed by a sniffling spirit. The spirit can be released, and it will rush straight ahead until it runs into an item that has a scent it loves. It will then haunt the person for a while and then go back to the land of the spirits.

name: Consolation Candy
description: This boiled sweet appears to be slightly past its best-before-date, or might have been stored in a cupboard next to an open can of Bow Meow food, as it has a rather unusual taste. Eating it might stop you crying, for a few minutes at least.

name: Ultra-Powerful Red Candy
description: This drop will increase your concentration during fights. Unfortunately, it tastes terrible. (DOUBLE-CLICK TO USE. Bonus 20 Wisdom and 10 Prospecting for the 30 next fights.)

name: Magic Book
description: This book appears to be magic. Very strange.

name: Pinchaut Bread
description: You get to eat and drink at the same time with this bread.

name: Home Potion
description: This potion brings you home whenever you want. If you don't have a home, then this potion will taste like wasted money and will teleport you to the place you're standing right now.

name: Scroll of Superhuman Reflexes
description: This parchment will make you sharper for your next fight.

name: Scroll of Subhuman Reflexes
description: This parchment will make you a bit inert at one point during the next fight.

name: Qui Leure Bread
description: Danioul Garnioul the Baker, a jealous rival of Xavier the Baker, came up with this recipe. Since his customers were always making fun of his ridiculous name, he avenged himself by kneading his dough with his bare feet. It's said his sales went through the roof.

name: Tahde Bread
description: This Bread contains tiny, delicious pieces of meat which look and taste like fowl. And yet, if you bring this bread to your nose, you will smell nothing but Tofu.

name: Mushden Ice Cream
description: This delightful ice cream is made using traditional methods by the small Mushden farm, whose mission is to make the mushd a basic element in all iced desserts.

name: Wayal Cone
description: The upper part of this ice cream was inspired by the famous Wa hat.

name: Bontarian Ice Cream
description: This ice cream, a subtle mixture of fruity flavours, is the result of the 'know-how of angels'. At least, that's what's written on the box.

name: Brakmarian Magma
description: This ice cream combines both crunchy and sweet ingredients, and 'shows once again why Brakmar is superior'. At least, that's what's written on the box.

name: Tofu Lollipop
description: This Tofu-flavoured lollipop is a delight for your taste buds, but a cataclysmic nightmare for your breath.

name: Trool Lollipop
description: A really delightful and endless lollipop. To be eaten with your friends, preferably.

name: Tofu Hot Dog
description: This fatty sausage will give you enough strength to digest all the other sausages you've eaten.

name: Trool Burger
description: This impressive burger could feed an army of starving Chafers. To be eaten in moderation. Too much Trool is dangerous for your health.

name: Wild Sunflower Chips
description: These chips are made from Wild Sunflower stems, and cooked in boiling Wild Sunflower oil for them to feel at home while they're frying.

name: Damaged Pair of Scissors
description: A pair of damaged scissors, nothing more.

name: Mimilk
description: Warning! As clearly specified on the package you should never give Mimilk to a young Bow Meow - it will ruin the carpets for sure.

name: Filled and Valid Form
description: This little form contains the name of a potential candidate for the baker's delivery man job.

name: Form to fill
description: This form looks like a simple sheet of paper. Get this though - one touch and the paper figures out if the person suits the criteria in the heading! Isn't that nuts?

name: Astrub Beer
description: A six pack of this classic brew is the only six pack you'll be seeing for a while.

name: Filled but invalid Form
description: This little form contains the name of a failed candidate for the baker's delivery man job. The small red mark at the bottom indicates that the poor sod didn't have enough Strength or Agility for the job.

name: Dofusian Gift
description: We won't spoil the surprise and tell you what's inside! Just have fun my friend and don't party too much!

name: Minotoball's Balls
description: These incredibly big balls are delicious. You'll think there's no end to them, but isn't that a good thing?

name: Brakmarian Intercity-Express Potion
description: This rice-based potion enables Brakmarians to return to their hometown instantaneously.

name: Bontarian Intercity-Express Potion
description: This rice-based potion enables Bontarians to return to their hometown instantaneously.

name: Full Soul Stone
description: This soul stone contains the souls of a group of monsters whose only wish is to come back to life to tear your body to pieces. It can only be used in special arenas, located in big cities.

name: Pandaburg
description: Pandaburg is a tasty drink which could very slowly make you blind, mute and deaf. How convenient! Pandawas aren't the speedy kind.

name: Pandapiler
description: According to the erudite Hel Munster, this genuine nectar delights the goddess Pandawa herself, making her completely euphoric. Any true Pandawa should give his Pandapilers away to the venerated goddess.

name: Pandapils
description: There's an odd old Pandawa custom that demands one toast by wearing a Tofu feather on one's head and singing: "Pandapils, Pandapils, lalalaLAleuh!" And that's by far not the worst...

name: Pandalartois
description: Pandalartois is a very toxic drink and its consumption (even in moderation) can lead to serious malfunction of the nervous system. But as it tastes good, Pandawas keep on drinking it everyday Pandawa makes.

name: Panduff
description: Ideal for libations to the goddess provided you perform the following ritual: lie down on the floor, face the statue, drink a mouthful of Panduff, then drink a big gulp, and finally – and most importantly – take a tiny sip of Panduff. Stare intensely into the eyes of the statue of the goddess. After doing this for a few days straight, she will appear to you. If she doesn't, go and see a shaman.

name: Panduvel
description: Give a Pandawa a fish and he'll eat all day. Teach a Pandawa how to fish and he'll spend his days in a rowing boat drinking Panduvel (old Pandawan saying).

name: Pandarium Tremens
description: "Pandarium Tremens proves Pandawa's love and her will to make us happy." This prayer of thanks addressed to the goddess is a pledge of peace between all Pandawas.

name: Vodkawa
description: "The only way to know if that glass of vodkawa will be one too many is to drink it." This ancient Pandawan proverb is behind much merriment (and more than a few unfortunate incidents). It is also the inspiration for some of world-famous musician Jon Lemon's greatest (and not-so-greatest) hits.

name: Pandneken
description: "It's true that Bwaks have short legs, but there'd be no point making them longer." This is the type of conversation you end up having after consuming Pandneken. That's why Pandawas now prefer to keep it for their libations to Pandawa.

name: Milk Chocolate Dofus
description: This Dofus has exceptional power: it can make you drool with joy.

name: White Chocolate Dofus
description: This Dofus has exceptional power: it can make you drool with joy.

name: Chocolate Panda
description: You think it's the chocolatey taste that makes this treat so special? Try a chocolate Ouassingue and you'll taste the difference.

name: Square of Milk Chocolate
description: Made with bamboo milk, this chocolate is a delight for kids and grown-ups so.

name: Square of White Chocolate
description: Are you dreaming of a square of white chocolate, just like the ones you used to know? Here y'are then. Just eat in moderation to avoid getting fat and unhealthy.

name: Square of Dark Chocolate
description: Directly extracted from cocoa beans, this square of dark chocolate is very tasty. Be careful not to eat too much of it, it'll give you the spotty skin of a 13-year-old, chain-smoking truck-driver.

description: Use this scroll to learn the Point emote, either to show the way or to tell on cheaters.

name: Golden Larva Egg
description: As strange as it may seem, these Golden Larva Eggs are not laid by Golden Larvae but by more common sorts – green, orange or even blue. Nature is just full of disappointing surprises.

name: Mass Resurrection Potion
description: This potion enables you to resurrect all the allies present around you.

name: Mass Liberation Potion
description: This potion enables you to free the souls of your enemies to send them directly to their cemetery, without giving them a chance to be resurrected.

name: Ripate Beer
description: This beer is so acidic it can hardly be drunk. Indeed, the acidity gives the pint the shelf-life of an overweight Moskito...

name: Foghorn
description: This foghorn is essential for calling to your mount to the rescue.

name: Snack Whistle
description: Have a break in the bosom of nature. Take your Snack Whistle out and your mount will arrive quicker than a Wabbit chasing a Cawwot.

name: Wisdom Candy
description:
This candy will increase Wisdom by 100 points for 30 fights.
(Warning! You can only use one candy at a time. If your character takes several different candies, their effects will not accumulate.)

name: Lucky Candy
description:
This candy will increase prospecting by 100 points for 30 fights.
(Warning! You can only use one candy at a time. If your character takes several different candies, their effects will not accumulate.)

name: Energy Candy
description: This candy will restore some energy if you're running low.

name: Hyrkul's Advent
description: Domen's Colossal, Immoral, Unusual Annals will send shivers down your spine. Must be read according to prescription. Side effects: cold sweats and bed wetting.

name: Compensation Gift
description:
To make up for the recent problems that you've encountered, the Ankama team has given you this gift box containing:
- 5 Compensation Wisdom Candies
- 5 Compensation Lucky Candies
- 10 Compensation Energy Candies
- 10 Eniripsa Powders

name: Bwork Beer
description: Bwork beer will make a Feca drunk from twelve paces, and a Sadida from fifteen feet. No one knows if it's made of Bworks or by Bworks, but knowing the Bworks, it's probably a bit of both.

name: Al Howin's Gift
description: Al Howin was the greatest Pumpkwin farmer on the continent. Unfortunately, he was also apprentice to a certain Bwork Magus who was far too interested in arcane knowledge for his own good. In order to win the 'Biggest Pumpkwin Cultivated with Lousy Pig Slurry' contest, Al Howin cheated by enlisting the help of the Bwork Magus, who decided to test a new incantation on the Pumpkwins... As a result of his idiocy, anyone who ate the bewitched fruits at a certain time of year wound up transformed into strange, misshapen creatures for several days... Apparently, the curse even spread to adventurers who got too close to the bewitched creatures. In desperation, the inhabitants of Amakna decided to start wearing Pumpkwins on their heads, hoping that this might somehow save them. The most surprising thing of all is that it seems to work!

name: Tiny Kwismas Gift
description: Season's greetings and warm wishes from everyone at Ankama. This gift will make you happier than you've ever been before.

name: Purse of 10,000 Kamas
description: This purse is very heavy - it must be worth a fortune.

name: Magic Yellow Balloon
description: This balloon can take off with grace and ease. A beauty to behold, it's handmade with genuine tofu feathers, based on the great magus Betsy Krokerr's original recipe.

name: Magic Red Balloon
description: This balloon can take off with grace and ease. A beauty to behold, it's handmade with genuine strawberry jelly eyelids, based on the great magus Betsy Krokerr's original recipe.

name: Bootlicker Potion
description:
This highly illegal potion is feared even by the strongest Pandawa warriors. A single gulp and you'll be obsessed with the idea of licking all footwear in sight. 
Students who are worried about their grades often use a similar potion for their teachers. Their breath smells slightly different though.

name: Kaniger Steak
description: Either hot or cold, this Kaniger steak will satisfy the most voracious of appetites.

name: Koalak Steak
description: This piece of meat will fill bottomless stomachs to the brim.

name: Preserved Crocodyl Gizzards
description: This impressive piece of meat is obviously extremely hard to digest. But just as your eyes are always hungrier than your stomach, so your stomach is always bigger than your brain. Fool!

name: Filtounga Dish
description: Filtounga is a unique dish. Its perfect melange of ingredients lends it a heavenly taste. Serve warm with a dash of cream and a sprig of fresh parsley.

name: Vampire Brain
description: Always overloaded with fresh globules, a vampire brain sucks in all the red blood cells it can. That's why vampires are so pale. As for Iops, it kind of explains their red feet.

name: Mumussel and Fries
description: From the depths of the Asse Sea, Mumussels collect kelp and roll it under their armpits. Once the material is shaped like French Fries, they reach the beach to brown them in the sun before eating them.

name: Industrial Troofle
description: This traditional cake, rolled in Trool droppings, is an old Bwork recipe. Only a Bwork who defeated a Trool with their bare hands is allowed to eat one. And frankly, after surviving that fight, they're probably ready to eat anything.

name: Magic Effect Thrower
description: This surprising item contains a dark, concentrated magic that some say is highly unstable. No one can predict the effects it may have, but one thing is certain: you shouldn't wait too long before you use it.

name: Piwi Egg
description: Piwi eggs are a real treat for those who have a sweet tooth! However, they hatch very quickly when they're close to a source of heat. That's why you shouldn't leave it in your pocket or in your mouth for too long! A mini Piwi could come out of its shell when you're just about to swallow. And trust me, having a starving Piwi stuck between your teeth or swimming its way through your intestines is not what you need if you're ticklish.

name: Incarnam Lemonade
description: This lemonade, made by the gods, is a mixture of water, bubbles, and animal extracts. It invigorates young souls on their arrival in Incarnam. For everyone else, this sparkling, vaguely yellow trash is just about good enough to use when training for burping contests.

name: Cuwsed Cawwot
description: This appetising Cawwot looks pwetty owdinawy but it stinks of evil fwom 50 paces. Will you wesist the temptation to devouw it?

name: Magic Blue Balloon
description: This balloon can take off with grace and ease. It's made with blue larva, which was gutted and then inflated by a Trool, based on the great magus Betty Krokerr's original recipe.

name: Magic Green Balloon
description: This green balloon is what you get when you feed a luigie mushroom to a green larva. The eyes of the larva roll out in the process and are sold to Bworks as appetisers. This balloon inspired the great magus Betsy Krokerr in some of her most famous recipes.

name: Cirsid Hizilinik
description: Tis dilicis-likiknik hizilnik liks nirmik bik riks ifik ivik. Cinik yik risisik tik timptitik ti nibblik ik ip?

name: Candied Chilli
description: This candied chilli is as explosive as the strainings from the devil's jockstrap. This mind bending mixture of sugar and fire led one Dragoturkey to a string of controversial victories in the World Dragokart championships before being banned by all major sporting associations. You can use it as a suppository if you need to make a quick exit or as a pill if getting in is your problem.

name: Purse of 5,000 Kamas
description: This purse is heavy - it must be worth a fair bit. A tradesman will be happy to exchange it for its value in kamas.

name: Purse of 1,000 Kamas
description: This purse is quite heavy - it must be worth something.

name: Guild House Potion
description: This potion enables you to get back to your guild house.

name: Bulbish Potion
description: This potion has been made from extracts of bulbs that soaked in Kloug mash. The most audacious alchemists use rice flour instead of Kloug mash, which can no longer be found. Even though it might seem impossible, you'll get used to its taste.

name: Empty Handyman Information Card

name: Vanilla Shigekax

name: Melon Shigekax
description: Rediscover the charm and flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made melon-flavoured candy. Wow! This Shigekax is definitely the best you've ever tasted.

name: Prism of Conquest
description: This magical stone can fill the darkest corner with a shimmering glow - no need to waste your precious urine to mark your territory. Not to be used in moderation if you have a conquering spirit. Warning! You can place a prism only if you clearly display your rank (with the player versus player mode activated), and if you are in an area with no other prisms. The area where you want to place a conquest prism must be adjoining at least a 5-minute old ally area.

description: Use this potion to teleport to Breeder Village.

name: Amaknian Aubergine Soup
description: This soup's strongest flavour is that of beer, which is why it is so well-loved by Amaknians.

name: Ballotwine Chocolates
description: You should give this small box to the one you love. If you're the kind of person who hates everyone, you may as well eat it yourself!

name: Heart-Shaped Fairywork
description: This special Fairywork will help spread the love. Can you feel it?

name: Passion Shigekax
description: Known for its aphrodisiac virtues, this sweet and soft candy is ideal as a gift for your loved one.

name: St. Ballotwine's Day Gift
description: This gift is a survival kit you might want to hold onto while going on dangerous love missions.

name: Soul Stone for Small Souls
description: This stone was invented by Otomai and is completely flawless. You are guaranteed to capture level 50 souls using it.

name: Soul Stone for Average Souls
description: This stone was invented by Otomai and is completely flawless. You are guaranteed to capture level 100 souls using it.

name: Soul Stone for Big Souls
description: This stone was invented by Otomai and is completely flawless. You are guaranteed to capture level 150 souls using it.

name: Soul Stone for Huge Souls
description: This stone was invented by Otomai and is completely flawless. You are guaranteed to capture level 250 souls using it.

name: Soul Stone for Gigantic Souls
description: This stone was invented by Otomai and is completely flawless. You are guaranteed to capture level 1000 souls using it.

name: Soul Stone for Gargantuan Souls
description: This unique stone was created with one single use in mind - to capture the soul of the Kralove. You can tell just by looking at it, or smelling it...

name: Total Camouflage Potion
description: This potion turns you invisible and allows you move without becoming visible.

name: Trashouflage Potion
description: This magic potion transforms you into a trash can. As soon as you move again, you'll take on your normal appearance.

name: Barrouflage Potion
description: This magic potion transforms you into a barrel. As soon as you move again, you'll take on your normal appearance.

name: Tombouflage Potion
description: This magic potion transforms you into a tomb. As soon as you move again, you'll take on your normal appearance.

name: Rockouflage Potion
description: This magic potion transforms you into a rock. As soon as you move again, you'll take on your normal appearance.

name: Stoolouflage Potion
description: This magic potion transforms you into a stool. As soon as you move again, you'll take on your normal appearance.

name: Logouflage Potion
description: This magic potion transforms you into a log. As soon as you move again, you'll take on your normal appearance.

name: Plantouflage Potion
description:
This potion will protect you from aggressive monsters.
It turns you into a plant. If you move, you return to your initial appearance.

name: Immobile Camouflage Potion
description: This potion turns you invisible but if you move, you'll become visible again.

name: Liberation Potion
description: This potion enables you to free the soul of an enemy, sending him directly to his grave and preventing him from being resurrected.

name: Guild Renaming Potion (Mod)
description: This potion lets you to rename a guild following a moderator decision.

name: Bottle of Greedoburg
description: This ultra-powerful mix of alcohol rips out your tongue, scrapes away your palate, burns your oesophagus and causes your stomach to explode before boiling your brain. In other words, it's a drink for real Pandawas. In tiny writing on the base of the bottle you can just about make out the following: "Consumption of alcoholic beverages may cause health problems. Drink in moderation, except when as an offering to the goddess".

name: Plate of Scrampi
description: This dish perfectly illustrates Donna Kerbabben's favourite saying: "If it ain't for frying, it ain't worth trying".

name: Kerbabben Salad
description: The name of this salad is a celebration of the day it was first created. It was served for the first time during the dubbing ceremony of the famous Iopette Donna Kerbabben. As with all foods destined for consumption by knights, it is strongly recommended that vegetarians give it a very wide berth.

name: Vaulting Rye Bread
description: Served at the great Jon Lemon's funeral, the taste and smell of this bread is so revolting that it would wake the dead... or kill the living. Perhaps that explains the singer's many comebacks.

name: Playful Claw Fairywork
description: When she was living in the Tower of Tough Love, Mily once ordered a huge number of Fairyworks from a famous craftsman to illuminate her garden parties. She still has some left and when she's in a good mood, she gives them out for free.

name: Rough Tongue Fairywork
description: When she was living in the Tower of Tough Love, Mily once ordered a huge number of fairyworks from a famous craftsman to illuminate her garden parties. She still has some left and when she's in a good mood, she gives them out for free.

name: Mily's Beauty Cream
description: Mily slaps this cream on her body every morning to keep herself looking young and beautiful. Just try it and the results will amaze you! Make sure you don't get into any fights while you have it on, though - the least effort will leave you looking like an old hag.

name: Intre Bread
description: This bread is highly prized by the Iop community for its ability to fill warriors with overwhelming courage. The numerous deaths caused by its consumption are proof that it works. Xavier the Baker stopped making it when a company of limp-wristed troubadours terrorised the region for an entire winter.

name: Fishy Salad
description: Wake up and smell the coffee, or so the saying goes. Well, this salad does not smell of coffee. It smells of fish. Fish and sweaty feet. Do not eat it in front of a rutting Lousy Pig, unless you're a female Lousy pig, that is.

name: Dungeon Keeper Soul Stone
description: This soul stone contains the souls of a group of monsters - including a dungeon keeper - whose only wish is to come back to life to tear your body to pieces. It can only be used in special arenas, located in big cities.

name: Archmonster Soul Stone
description: This soul stone contains the souls of a group of monsters – including at least one archmonster – whose only wish is to come back to life to tear your body to pieces. It can only be used in special arenas located in big cities.

name: Soul Capture Scroll
description: This scroll will teach you the special spell Soul Capture.

name: Moon Hammer Scroll
description: This scroll will teach you the elementary spell Moon Hammer.

description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

name: Gobball-meat Pasty
description: You'll need a strong stomach to swallow this pasty. The gobball meat used in it, not always the freshest cut it has to be said, gives it a flavour akin to oysters in chocolate. Bworks go mad for it.

name: Treechorn
description: If you rub this tiny acorn gently, it will begin to swell, and after a short time, if you rub a little more, the Treechnid trapped inside it will come bursting out.

name: Jorbak's Chest
description: Jorbak lost his entire fortune, could it be hidden inside this strange trunk? Open it and find out.

name: Prancing Chimera Potion
description: That'll teach you to drink whatever is put in front of you!

name: The Puddlies' Scroll
description: As easy to follow as a Wabbit Wecipe, this scroll's text reveals a bewitching secret.

name: HmmMmm Potion
description: HmmMmm.

name: Dofusian Gift
description: We won't spoil the surprise and tell you what's inside! Just have fun my friend and don't party too much!

name: Kill Coos Shigekax
description: Rediscover the flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made candy, which will increase both Prospecting and Wisdom by 100 points for 20 fights.

name: How to Travel Without Ever Losing Your Way - Volume II
description: Wally Elconom wrote this book for any adventurer who doesn't know their compass from their Zaaps.

name: Primitive Potion
description: This ethereal potion can only be consumed by the person who finds it. It will strengthen the link between their soul and their body.

name: Novice Healing Potion
description: This flask once contained a urine sample. Now it contains a potion that'll give you back some HP. Was it washed beforehand? Dare you to find out!

name: Novice Bread
description: It's bone-dry, you'll break your teeth on it, it smells of unwashed Bwork underpants, but it'll give you back some HP, so stop pulling that face and swallow it down.

name: Novice Fish
description: If you hit this fish, you'll hear it echo. Hit yourself while you're eating it and you'll transform yourself into a musical instrument.

name: Novice Pasty
description: Take a small amount of anything indigestible you can find in the country of Amakna, blend it up with some red-hot spices, wrap it in rancid, sweaty pastry, and you'll end up with this nigh-on inedible pasty. Pushed into a young Feca's mouth, it makes a great dummy, though.

name: Golden Dragoone Gift
description: If you shake this gift box vigorously, you'll find it's not empty. Perhaps the gods are finally smiling down on you.

name: Larval Healing Potion
description: A bubbly, orange liquid that no one would want to drink.

name: Cracklerock
description:
This polished stone contains a Crackrock who is anything but polished.
It appears that you can only use it near other Cracklers or Crackrocks.

name: Catbread
description: This bread is amazing! When you bite it, it meows!

name: Monster Bread
description:
Sometimes, when you eat very stale bread, you might lose a tooth. If you eat this bread, stale or not, you'll lose all of your teeth.
This magical bread may only be eaten in Sufokia Bay.

name: Usable Monster Bread
description: This one is more tender. Bon appétit!

name: Hulkrap Relic
description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

name: Klume Relic
description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

name: Kloug Relic
description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

name: Name Change Potion
description: You can use this potion to change your name. No one will remember that you used to be called Xx-Haxor-naruto-killer-feca-xX-pl. A new life, free from teasing and name-calling, awaits you. Finally, you will be someone.

name: Colour Change Potion
description: Pink hair, mauve socks, fuchsia skin. Mother Nature wasn't kind to you, but now you've finally got the opportunity to change things. Mustard yellow, here you come!

name: Sex Change Potion
description: This potion, to be drunk directly from the bottle, will allow you to become him if you were her, or to become her if you were him. To be consumed without moderation.

name: Manitou Zoth Relic
description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

name: Dofus 2.0 Beta Test Dungeon Gift
description: You've been given this gift because you spent more time in the DOFUS 2.0 Beta Test dungeons than any other mortal.

name: DOFUS 2.0 Collector's Edition Gift
description: This set will make a star of you, if you can keep your mouth shut. But don't worry, even if you can't, it'll still impress the inhabitants of Astrub.

name: Mr. Scouty's Recall Potion
description:
Twice as creamy and twice as unctuous a "classic" recall potion, Mr. Scouty's Recall Potion will allow you to teleport to the Astrub Zaap from anywhere. The potion's double effect ensures you will live long and prosper.
"Mr. Scouty's Recall Potion" is a registered trademark of Keurk & Stok Enterprises.

name: Ridiculous Kwismas Gift
description: Not all Kwismas gifts are the same size. Timid adventurers only get ridiculous gifts, as well as the right to be teased or burst into tears.

name: Incredible Kwismas Gift
description: Whoever gave you this gift is clearly very pretentious. They thought it contained something incredible.

name: Potentially Ultra-Powerful Kwismas Gift
description: If you believe what's written on the label, this gift has potential. However, as any experienced adventurer will tell you - never trust what's written on the label.

name: Plunder Relic
description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

name: Larva Brain
description: You'd need to be really desperate to eat this. No, don't do it!

name: Wefweshing Potion
description: The sweetness of a Cawwot, the freshness of a Dragoturkey marathon runner. There's nothing better for getting you back on your feet. Good health, up the empire, cheers!

name: Potion: Destination Unknown
description: Your instinct tells you not to swallow the contents of this jar. Not just your instincts, either. Your nose, too. The mixture smells like a centenarian Bwork's armpit.

name: Festive Fairywork
description: PAR-TAY! PAR-TAY! PAR-TAY!

name: Phong Huss Relic
description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

name: Ektope Relic
description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

name: Sack of Snowdrops
description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Snowdrops.

name: Sack of Icefish
description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Icefish.

name: Sack of Aspen Wood
description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Aspen Wood.

name: Sack of Frosteez
description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Frosteez.

name: Sack of Obsidian
description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Obsidian.

name: Uridnac
description:
This little fish is very fond of people and attaches itself to them easily.
However, its biological rhythm is peculiar: it is only active in the month of Aperirel when Silouate warms the fresh water where the fish thrives.

name: Vibrating Pingwin Feather
description: Following the example set by the Royal Tofu, certain Pingwins grow a vibrating feather that is chock-full of magic. As for its usefulness...

name: Apewicube
description: There's something trapped in this cube of ice cut from Frigost's Frozen Lake. You've got two options if you want to find out what it is: wait until the ice melts, or, like any self-respecting brat, hit it until it shatters.

name: Izterik Fairywork
description: This fairywork produces a pleasant pyrotechnic effect for a few seconds and burns your retinas for the rest of your life.

name: Az le Tech's Cursed Treasure
description: Az le Tech wanted to trade this treasure for his freedom with the Enutrof conqueror Sétroc. Once in his possession, Sétroc did not keep his word and executed Az le Tech. As he lay dying, he cast a curse that will befall anyone who lays their hands on this treasure.

name: Ougicle Relic
description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

name: Karotz Relic
description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

name: Grouillot Relic
description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

name: Kubitus Relic
description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

name: Piggy Paupe Relic
description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

name: Rapiat Relic
description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

name: Friswein
description: This drink is very sweet and has the distinction of being made from frozen grapes. This explains its rarity and its unique, refined taste.

name: Frigrowka
description: Also known as the "Mastogob grass drink", Frigrowka is said to facilitate human contact and address difficult issues. As for Frigostians, they drink it mostly because they like to drink.

name: Roast Mastogob Leg
description: Any wiry, black, curly hairs you find sticking out of this roast haven't come from the Mastogob, oh no. They belong to your sweetheart.

name: Roast Royal Mastogob Leg
description: Sink your teeth into this leg and you'll feel like you're biting your mother-in-law. You'll ask for more, though, just you wait and see.

name: Cooked Cube of Meat
description: Recommended by the militiamen of Frigost, this cube of meat is the perfect thing to get you back on your feet after a difficult fight.

name: Grilled Pingwin Flesh
description: Just enjoy the gritty crunch, it tastes just like chicken!

name: Grilled Royal Pingwin Flesh
description: This dish smells of gamey meat and rotten fish, but what did you expect? You were warned not to reheat defrosted food.

name: Snowfoux Steak
description: Eat this meat at every meal for a month and you'll be fat enough to serve as an appetiser for the YeCh'Ti.

name: Tengu Snowfoux Steak
description: What doesn't kill you makes your stronger, which you'll be living testament to if you survive the terrible indigestion this meat provokes.

name: Adventurer Meat
description: Use this meat on the Lonesome Pine Trails to make a starving Sabredon appear.

name: Frosteez Bread
description: This bread is the staple food of Frigostians, which explains why they've withstood the famine for nearly a century.

name: Puffed Frosteez Bread
description: This bread is the staple food of Frigostian aristocrats, which explains why their first bowel movement of the day comes earlier than that of their less aristocratic peers.

name: Gutrot Potion
description: This unpalatable potion will force you to make a crucial choice between drinking it to save your life in agony, or dying but suffering less.

name: Raid Rayve Potion
description: This potion will carry you away from the spirit realm, and get you back on your feet.

name: Starry Potion
description: Use this potion to travel to the stars without leaving your house. Certain gullible Frigostians even claim that it brings good luck.

name: Icefish Fricassee
description: Once you taste it, you won't be able to do without it.

name: Frozen Icefish Fricassee
description: They say that eating Frozen Icefish makes you smarter. Yet another story told to young Iops to make them eat.

name: Royal Mastogob Spiritual Gem
description:
Awarded to the victor of a certain number of duels, this gem contains the soul of a monster.
Keep in a cool, dry, dark place, away from strong odours. Shake well before use.

name: Royal Pingwin Spiritual Gem
description:
Awarded to the victor of a certain number of duels, this gem contains the soul of a monster.
Keep in a cool, dry, dark place, away from strong odours. Shake well before use.

name: Barnaby Bundle
description: This method of transport is uncomfortable, that's for sure, but it's the only method you've found for crossing the barrier between Barnaby's worlds. (DOUBLE-CLICK to use.)

name: Mastogob Black Pudding Pizza
description: Even if you don't start eating it for another hundred years, you will finish this pizza well before Rattedaugue has successfully made Gonztipay laugh.

name: Hungry Planet Guide - Discover Frigost
description: This book is in terrible condition and looks pretty ancient - like its content, for that matter. If you read it, you'll certainly know more about Frigost than your rucksack. Well, if you'd arrived a century earlier, perhaps.

name: Memoirs of a Hothead
description: An extract of Hazieff Taroun's memoirs.

name: Imperial Paté
description: This dish, presented as a local speciality, was actually developed by Frigostian restaurateurs after the influx of tourists. Playing on the gullibility of adventurers willing to swallow anything, the Frigostians were able to keep their food supplies intact.

name: Slightly Prosperous Humbug
description:
Before the big freeze, Laurent Gebleuh was often accompanied by his YeCh'Ti, George. George was sweet, George was cool, but after the big freeze, he became a bit of a pain in the arse. That's why Laurent Gebleuh prefers humbugs to George.
This humbug increases your Prospecting by 25 points for 10 fights.

name: Prosperous Humbug
description:
Before the big freeze, Laurent Gebleuh was often accompanied by his YeCh'Ti, George. George was sweet, George was cool, but after the big freeze, he became a bit of a pain in the arse. That's why Laurent Gebleuh prefers humbugs to George.
This humbug increases your Prospecting by 50 points for 15 fights.

name: Slightly Expert Humbug
description:
Before the big freeze, Laurent Gebleuh was often accompanied by his YeCh'Ti, George. George was sweet, George was cool, but after the big freeze, he became a bit of a pain in the arse. That's why Laurent Gebleuh prefers humbugs to George.
This humbug increases your Wisdom by 25 points for 10 fights.

name: Expert Humbug
description:
Before the big freeze, Laurent Gebleuh was often accompanied by his YeCh'Ti, George. George was sweet, George was cool, but after the big freeze, he became a bit of a pain in the arse. That's why Laurent Gebleuh prefers humbugs to George.
This humbug increases your Wisdom by 50 points for 15 fights.

name: Sleeping Voracious Chest
description: This Voracious Chest is asleep. If you want to find out what it's hiding in its belly, you'll need to wake it up - but you do so entirely at your own risk.

name: A Flash of Lightning, a Flashing Scythe
description: Song taken from a Collection of Farmers' Songs.

name: Eliatrope Fantasy
description:
There is almost nothing left of the Eliatrope civilisation.
A few ruins, some petroglyphs, faded memories. Since ancient times, important ceremonies were celebrated with a shower of petals. According to Lyrad the Silent, this ritual dates back to the first Eliatropes who opened their initiation with a rain of Wakfu.

name: Bag of Eliatrope Fantasies
description: This bag contains plenty of Eliatrope Fantasies.

name: On Wakfu
description: This rare, unholy book, cursed by many and banned from all the libraries, is supposed to have been written by Lyrad the Silent, a charlatan who lived a very long time ago (and who is supposed to still be alive, from what we've heard). The Gods themselves have forbidden their followers from reading it. Even having it on your person is punishable by terrible penalties.

name: Me, Missiz Freezz
description: This document reveals a very well-kept secret. Well, very well-kept until today, that is.

name: The Day After the Avalanche
description: Long John gave you this book to help you understand the history of the village.

name: Brockhard Flank Steak with Cream
description: This succulent Flank Steak gives off a light aroma of chocolate, which is a great way of getting your kids to eat something other than beef burgers.

name: Professor Xa Flank Steak with Cream
description: This succulent Flank Steak gives off a light aroma of chocolate, which is a great way of getting your kids to eat something other than beef burgers.

name: Smoked Bearbarian Breast
description: There's a rumour going round that Frigostian lumberjacks' bad tempers and weight comes from having overeaten this meat, which, rich in calories, formed their basic diet.

name: Smoked Celestial Bearbarian Breast
description: Larger than those of Samantha Lenald and a lot more appetising, this breast meat will please the most chaste of men.

name: Pair of Disposable Rustic Skis
description:
Thanks to these low-cost skis, you'll be able to travel across the snows to the Frigostian Carrier.
Please note that these skis wear out very quickly, and can only be used once.

name: Pair of Disposable Slippery Skis
description:
Thanks to these low-cost skis, you'll be able to travel across the snows to the Royal Mastogob's Greenhouse.
Please note that these skis wear out very quickly, and can only be used once.

name: Pair of Disposable Dark Skis
description:
Thanks to these low-cost skis, you'll be able to travel across the snows to the Royal Pingwin's Excavation.
Please note that these skis wear out very quickly, and can only be used once.

name: Pair of Disposable Supple Skis
description:
Thanks to these low-cost skis, you'll be able to travel across the snows to the entrance of Frigost Village.
Please note that these skis wear out very quickly, and can only be used once.

description: Season's greetings and warm wishes from everyone at Ankama. This gift will make you happier than you've ever been before.

name: Rogue Elixir
description: A good slug of this and you'll be teleported to the Rogue Temple. Known side effects: hiccups, apparition of in-laws, hair loss, dog breath, untied shoelaces, successive red traffic lights.

name: Thwee Kings Gift
description: If you don't like this gift, you can always sell it in Astrub.

name: Stale Kwismas Log

name: Wise Rebirth Candy
description:
This candy will increase Wisdom by 100 points for 10 fights.
(Please note that you can only use one candy at a time. If you character consumes more than one, their effects will not accumulate)

This candy will increase prospecting by 100 points for 10 fights.
(Please note that you can only use one candy at a time. If you character consumes more than one, their effects will not accumulate)

name: Kwismas Sweet
description:
This sweet, which is full of the magic of Kwismas, increases you Prospecting and Wisdom by 30 during 20 fights.
(Remember, you can only use one sweet at a time and if your character eats several, the effects will not be carried over).

name: Chocrosis Infecting Agent
description: This terrible object will inflict the Chocrosis Curse onto any target of your choice. Make sure you don't use it on yourself!

description: Information about Eniripsas.

name: The Masqueraider Mystique
description: Various information about the Masqueraiders.

name: The Greatest Adventure of All Time
description: This work is signed by Herdegrize the Mystic.

name: Ensafalon Corktail
description: Lying on a beach under a palm tree with an Ensafalon Corktail in your hand can make you feel out of this world. Say goodbye to that migraine that's been bothering you!

name: Sludgepuppy Corktail
description: This Corktail with a hint of lingering wet earth odour is a particular favourite of Enutrofs and earthworms.

name: Emachus Corktail
description: Invented by Nono the Boombot, this alcohol-free drink is great for children, but we don't advise its consumption by Pandawas.

name: Vulkania, Land of Adventure
description: This prospectus lists all the activities available on Vulkania Island. Please do not litter. That's not in the list.

name: The Legend of Grozilla and Grasmera
description: This book sheds light on some of the mysteries surrounding the Lords of Vulkania. Not exactly light bedtime reading if you're prone to nightmares.

name: Of Sauroshells and Dreggons
description: Written by Dina Tapio, an expert on Vulkanian Dracology, this book gives us an in-depth look at Dreggon reproduction.

name: Vulkanian Picnic
description: This basket is full of everything you need to have a successful picnic in the forest: a tub of Plimok soup, some mud pies, a tourist season salad and an assortment of dried-up fruit. Once you've finished your feast, you'll be able to take a little nap in the shade of the palm trees! Watch out for those bloody ants who are lurking around though.

name: Tourist Survival Rations
description: These rations, which have a peculiar taste, are old pieces of bread, soaked in Oilbow Grease before being rolled around the armpits. They keep for a very long time: it's not uncommon for them to survive longer than those who eat them.

name: Plimok Soup
description: This typically Vulkanian soup is made from a mix of spices, salt crystals and rotten vegetables. Considered out of this World by most mere mortals, it is particularly invigorating to the organism. It is, in fact, so delicious that it is only consumed in small quantities: just one teaspoonful is perfectly adequate for a meal. Swallowing any more could result in uncontrollable spasms which could make you look like a plimok.

name: Leecha Tongued Fricassee
description: Don't be fooled by appearances: this dish is absolutely delicious. The Leecha Tongue is a somewhat strange looking fish which is strangely reminiscent of a Clementine Boot. The texture of its bitter-sweet flesh is much more digestible than an old sole though.

name: How to Become the Perfect Recruit
description: How to fall into line without choosing sides, or rules to follow for  a militiaman's life, by Ganymede.

name: Crimson Dawn (part 1) - Found Fragments IX
description: Volume IX of the Fragments of the History of the World, found by the academic, Acidrik Gutsplitter, and rewritten by him.

name: Crimson Dawn (part 2) - Found Fragments X
description: Volume X of the Fragments of the History of the World, found by the academic, Acidrik Gutsplitter, and rewritten by him.

name: Esra'Ruoy'Dnim's Invasion
description: This work is a copy of one of the royal library's manuscripts. The original text was transcribed by George Segrob the archivist, which means its authenticity is guaranteed.

name: Chocolate Pricky
description: Always dreamt of having your own hearty coat of resin and pine needles to protect against the cold? Eat this chocolate and your wish might come true!

name: Chocolate Gift Package
description: Always dreamt of bursting out of a huge present during an important function, wearing nothing but a Boowolf Thong? Eat this chocolate and your wish might come true!

name: Chocolate Soft Toy
description: Always dreamt of being snuggled all day long and to have itchy, synthetic hairs growing all over you? Eat this chocolate and your wish might come true!

name: Ice Sugar Snowman
description: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Snowman. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

name: Ice Sugar Wintry Kaniger
description: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Wintry Kaniger. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

name: Ice Sugar Snow Yiti
description: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Snow Yiti. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

name: Ice Sugar Mini Inuit
description: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Mini Inuit. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

name: Gingerbread Sleigh
description: Eating this baked delight will really get you into the Kwismas spirit: you'll suddenly be surrounded by snow, you'll be somewhat stouter than before and you'll become diabetic.

name: Snowboole
description: This fairywork is very easy to use: just aim for a friend's face, and fire! That should leave them frozen to the spot.

name: Snowfall Fairywork
description: The perfect fairywork for sending chills up your new friends' spines.

name: Rint Relic
description: This relic contains the signal and ceremonial weapon of the sidekick of the same name.

name: Kwismas Log
description: The fire that burns in your belly will make short work of this Kwismas Log. Rumour has it that one of the Thwee Kings, Balt Hasaw, loves eating Kwismas Logs.

name: Kwismas Star Gift
description: Check out this magnificent gift, wrapped in magnificent, starry wrapping paper. Who knows what's inside it? Why, the person who wrapped it, of course, and they wish you a merry Kwismas!

name: Scarlet Kwismas Gift
description: Check out this magnificent gift, wrapped in magnificent, bright red wrapping paper. Who know's what's inside it? Why, the person who wrapped it, of course, and they wish you a merry Kwismas!

name: Snowy Kwismas Gift
description: Check out this magnificent gift, with its magnificent, Kwismassy wrapping paper. Who knows what's inside it? Why, the person who wrapped it, of course, and they wish you a merry Kwismas!

name: Jim Ger's Roots
description: Spending all day talking to adventurers who are each stupider than the last can soften up even the firmest of husbands. Mary uses a root-based recipe discovered by the famous biologist Jim Ger to help Harry stay in shape when he starts slacking off.

name: Blank Label
description: You can write the name of the person to whom you want to send the gift on this label.

name: White Fleaster Fairywork
description: An invaluable item for lifting the atmosphere at those extra-slushy weddings. Also very useful for drowning out the sound of those silly little chuckles the bride tends to let out.

name: The Legend of Jeff Stobbs
description: Within this collection, you'll find a series of engravings which illustrate one of Herdegrize the Mystic's works. It was printed in Astrub by a highly-respected Goblin. Yes, you heard right; a highly-respected Goblin!

name: The Gweat Wabbit's Prophecy
description: This book bears the seal of the Astrub printers and is considered a holy book amongst Wabbits.

name: Portation Corktail
description: Kick back and relax on a sandy beach, in the shade of a palm tree, Portation Corktail in hand. You'll really feel like you're somewhere else.

name: Red Rock Candy
description: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Pink Dragoone. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

name: Yellow Rock Candy
description: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Golden Dragoone. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

name: Guild Emblem Change Potion
description: It's never easy to wear your guild's colours proudly when the emblem is a butt-ugly shade of neon green. With this potion you'll finally be able to give your guild an emblem that lives up to your ambitions as guild master.

name: Guild Renaming Potion
description: Guilds have pasts, and so do guild masters. It's not exactly easy to live with the mistakes of your youth. A "there" instead of a "their", leaving out the "r" in "shirt", a split infinitive – so many reasons you might want to change a guild name. Now you can!

name: Stewed Frozen Icefish
description: They say that eating Frozen Icefish makes you smarter. Yet another story told to young Sadidas to make them eat Icefish.

name: Foggernauts' Steam
description: Information about Foggernauts.

name: Foggernaut Elixir
description: A good slug of this and you'll be teleported to the Foggernaut Temple. Known side effects: hiccups, apparition of in-laws, hair loss, dog breath, untied shoelaces, successive red traffic lights.

name: Magic Portable Balloon
description: Contrary to the fake ones that one might find at the Trool Fair, this balloon won't deflate and will follow you no matter the danger. It was made by hand out of pet shadows and good old-fashioned Astrubian fish glue, using the traditional recipe by Berry Pills.

name: Gobtubby Astromagical Potion
description: Those who claim that the signs of the Doziak have no real-world influence have obviously never consumed an astromagical potion. Ever dreamed of looking like someone born under the sign of Gobball? Your wish will soon come true. The effects of this potion will disappear if you get in a fight.

name: Gobball - Signs of the Doziak I
description: If you were born between the 21st of Martalo and the 20th of Aperirel, you should find this little book by Yova Etna very interesting indeed.

name: Be cold
description: Use this scroll to learn the Be Cold emote. You'll be able to play it cool thanks to the refreshing breath of Inooni, the Meridia of Frost.

name: Emote Scroll: Kowtow
description: Use this scroll to learn the Kowtow emote. It's very handy for kneeling in front of the altars in the Almanax Sanctuary, or to curry favour with your guild leader.

name: Emote Scroll: Be Hot
description: Use this scroll to learn the Be Hot emote. No doubt Troyle, the Meridia of Hot Flushes, will be pleased to see you as red as a Strawberry Jelly.

name: Emote Scroll: Flex Muscles
description: Use this scroll to learn the Flex Muscles emote. Finally, you'll be able to impress Eltruteht, the Meridia of Muscles, and show off your biceps in front of the puny runts in Astrub.

name: Emote Scroll: Read a Map
description: Use this scroll to learn the Read a Map emote. Sad, the Meridia of the Sense of Direction, has shown you the way. Now use it wisely!
