name: Emote Scroll: Raised Fist
description: Use this scroll to learn the Raised Fist emote.

name: Emote Scroll: Thumb Your Nose
description: Use this scroll to learn the Thumb Your Nose emote.

name: Emote Scroll: Draw Attention
description: Use this scroll to learn the Draw Attention emote.

name: Emote Scroll: Mum's The Word
description: Use this scroll to learn the Mum's The Word emote.

name: Emote Scroll: Rub Hands
description: Use this scroll to learn the Rub Hands emote.

name: Trikortritt Surprise
description: Tirkortritt loves Al Howin's Day tricks. To share his joy and love for this special day, he has decided to scatter surprise gifts all around. Trikortritt is a joker and a disciple of Asid, the god of Fear. Who knows what he could have hidden in this box?

name: Al Howin's Treat
description: This treat was hidden in Trikortritt's surprise box. Its taste (a mixture of Cawwot, Pumpkwin and Orange Larva juice) is a delight to children, parents and even dentists.

name: Temple of Scriptures Potion
description: This potion will allow you to teleport to the Temple of Scriptures, otherwise known as the Almanax Sanctuary. Now you have no excuse to not make an offering!

name: Strawberry Lolly
description: There's nothing better than a good old-fashioned Al Howin's Lolly to get your teeth rotting nice and quick. This treat will increase your Intelligence in exchange for Vitality for your next fight.

name: Api Lolly
description: There's nothing better than a good old-fashioned Al Howin's Lolly to get your teeth rotting nice and quick. This treat will increase your Strength in exchange for Vitality for your next fight.

name: Lemon Lolly
description: There's nothing better than a good old-fashioned Al Howin's Lolly to get your teeth rotting nice and quick. This treat will increase your Agility in exchange for Vitality for your next fight.

name: Plum Lolly
description: There's nothing better than a good old-fashioned Al Howin's Lolly to get your teeth rotting nice and quick. This treat will increase your Chance in exchange for Vitality for your next fight.

name: Cheweez
description: Al Howin force-fed his Devhorror Cheweez to make it more powerful. Not only did it work, but its mouth became so saturated in sugar and cariogenic bacteria that even its gentlest bite can make your teeth fall out. This treat will dramatically increase your Power in exchange for Vitality for your next fight.

name: Mind-Blowing Candy Kebab
description: Not to be sold at all. This sweet is so full of psychoactive substances that it will make you believe that a Borbkin is following you. Prepare to get a fright every time you turn around.

name: Hallucinogenic Candy Kebab
description: Not to be sold at all. This sweet is so full of psychoactive substances that it will make you believe that a Toadkin is following you. Prepare to get a fright every time you turn around.

name: Emote Scroll: Al Howin
description: Use this scroll to learn how to shake it in the dark to make it glow. It works in the daytime too, although it's much less effective. We're talking about shaking your Pumpkwin Head... You know that, right?

name: Compensation Gift
description: Not to be confused with the consolation prizes you're so used to, this gift has been given to you to make up for the inconvenience you suffered. Inside, you'll find 30 compensokens that you can trade in with Pauly Gees at the Amakna Castle zaap at [3,-5].

name: Prospector Candy
description: This candy will grant you a Prospecting bonus of 100 points for your next fight.

name: Formative Candy
description: This candy will grant you a Wisdom bonus of 100 points for your next fight.

name: Chichala Flask
description: This potion is one of the most powerful an alchemist can craft and its recipe is jealously kept secret by the oldest among them. When interrogated, they have a tendency to complicate the recipe, stating that it needs ingredients that are simply impossible to find just to discourage competition.

name: Plerti's Cylinder Gift
description: This gift is offered as compensation for a problem in DOFUS. You can use it on any character, but only those that haven't finished the Year of the Dragon (Dolmanax) quest and have fewer than 365 Calendar Pages can be awarded one. You can collect your reward from Antyklime Ax.

name: Emote Scroll: Piwi
description: Use this scroll to learn the Piwi emote. Mylka's disciples use it just after leaping off cliffs and just before crashing dismally in a cloud of dust.

name: Emote Scroll: Cheer On
description: Use this scroll to learn the Cheer On emote. Totot, the Meridia of Enthusiasm, is always telling people to share their joy with the world rather than keeping it bottled up, so feel free to jump around and get the troops psyched up. Waahoooo!

name: Karnaval Doughnut
description: You found this doughnut inside a Party Bag, and it looks so good that you're drooling. Go on, hang the diet and scoff the lot! You can shrug off your spare tyre next time the Brakmarathon comes round.

name: Party Bag
description: What could be inside this Party Bag? The only way to find out is to take a deep breath and open it up...!

name: Face Change Potion
description: Consume to acquire 15 loyalokens.

name: Caramel Rabmarac Bar
description: Legend says that the recipe of this chewy little bar is kept secret by the god Rabmarac. Nobody can resist the authentic taste, nor the painstaking humour of the joke that can be found on the inside of the wrapper.

name: Strawberry Rabmarac Bar
description: This chewy bar will light up the cheeks of girls and boys alike. Want to know why? Maybe it's because of the Rabmajoke written on the inside of the wrapper, but we can't be sure...

name: Lemon Rabmarac Bar
description: To be consumed in moderation, especially when you're in a hurry. Take the time to read the joke on the inside of the wrapper - it'd be a real shame to miss out on it...!

name: Orange Rabmarac Bar
description: It is said that Nitsougnal absolutely loves this chewy little sweet. Given its colour, that's probably to be expected, but he also loves the hilarious joke written on the inside of the wrapper.

name: Kola Rabmarac Bar
description: John Pesterton wanted to recreate the taste of his Cocalane and pop it into a chewy treat. The god Rabmarac is no stranger to the fact that the supposedly miraculous drink invented by the alchemist was none other than a bad joke. In any case, while the taste of this Kola bar has been imitated, the Rabmajoke that's written on the inside of the wrapper is inimitable.

name: Nougat Rabmarac Bar
description: This chewy bar is reserved for dungeon keepers only. Any monster able to swallow one whole will be abandoned in the arena at the mercy of cruel and avid adventurers. Before passing away, the carefree creature is allowed to read the Rabmajoke written on in the inside of the wrapper just to get one last laugh out of life.

name: Large Unikron Horn
description: This cristalline horn contains 5 doses of a powerful healing philter. With each use, it gets slightly smaller but will keep its shape and size in the cold.

name: Long Unikron Horn
description: This cristalline horn contains 4 doses of a powerful healing philter. With each use, it gets slightly smaller, yet even if it's been used, it'll still be an acceptable shape and size.

name: Short Unikron Horn
description: This cristalline horn contains 3 doses of a powerful healing philter. With each use, it gets slightly smaller, but don't go thinking the smaller ones are the better ones.

name: Small Unikron Horn
description: This cristalline horn contains 2 doses of a powerful healing philter. With each use, it gets slightly smaller, but don't go thinking the smaller ones are the better ones.

name: Tiny Unikron Horn
description: This cristalline horn contains the last dose of a powerful healing philter. Once it's been used, there'll be nothing left of it. You'll need to find a bigger Unikron Horn if you're planning on impressing the apprentice alchemists.

name: Snapper a la Kerub
description: A promising dish that will pleasantly surprise your taste buds... Once you get over the fishy smell, that is!

name: Pyrofuego
description: They say that the first Pyrofuegos were particularly magnificent. Since the fires they caused were equally spectacular, explosives manufacturers saw their sales drop. They had to do something and so now spectators can stand and marvel before these beautiful lights with no fear of danger.

name: Ice Sugar Snowball
description: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Snowball. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

name: Ice Sugar Ice Crackler
description: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of an Ice Crackler. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

name: Ice Sugar Sakai Firefoux
description: When you eat this sweet treat, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Sakai Firefoux. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

name: Kwismas Pastry
description: This pastry is much more pleasant when it's not fighting back! Beware of its side effects, though...

name: Kwismas Pastry Monster
description:
Sometimes, a Kwismas Pastry needs an extra grilling. Have a bite of this one; it'll keep you on your toes.
This pastry can only be eaten on Kwismas Island.

name: Kerub Potion
description: This potion will allow you to teleport to Kerub Crepin's house in Astrub. It will also magically clean all that poop from the soles of your shoes!

name: Emote Scroll: Write
description: Use this scroll to learn the Write emote. We're not expecting you to be the next Acidrik Gutsplitter, but at least don't write any more of that bwork poetry this time.

name: Letter from Kerub
description: You found this letter in a gift envelope. The paper shines with an iridescent gloss. Could it be magic? To know more, why don't you go and wish Kerub Crepin a merry Kwismas? He's waiting for you at his house in Astrub.

name: Gift Envelope
description: What could be in this envelope? Open it, quick!

name: Collection of Rabmajokes
description: A compilation of the jokes printed on the backs of Rabmarac wrappers. A summit of humour for kids, grown-ups and Goblins.

name: Argon Gass Krospack
description: This Krospack contains the Argon Gass Krosmaster figurine. Open it quick!

name: Goultard the Barbarian Krospack
description: This Krospack contains the Goultard the Barbarian Krospack. Open it quick!

name: Brotherhood Krospack
description: This Krospack contains a randomly selected Krosmaster figurine from the Brotherhood of the Tofu. Open it quick!

name: Soul Pearl
description: According to the old sailors' tales, Soul Pearls are made by mermaids and left at the surface when their owners come up for a breath of fresh air and a singsong. If you swallow this pearl, you should definitely stay away from fishmongers, unless you want to end up as sushi.

name: Wild Gobbagum
description: Kroketh's followers can be seen furiously chomping on this kind of Gobbagum before Gobbowl matches. Made from desiccated jerky, aromatic herbs and swathes of fur, this chewy confectionery helps them seize life – and their opponents – by the throat. It also grants a nice little Prospecting bonus.

name: Peach Gobbagum
description:
Totot's disciples can be seen enthusiastically chewing on this kind of Gobbagum the night before a big match. There's nothing better for a soft complexion and a peachy glow. Made from fruit of the finest quality, it's 100% pip-free.
It also grants a nice little Vitality bonus.

name: Fresh Lavender Gobbagum
description:
Kham's disciples can be seen conscientiously masticating this kind of Gobbagum at the beginning of a match, to make sure their breath stays fresh all game long. Just because you're going to give your enemy a thumping, doesn't mean you want to envelop him in morning breath. 
It also grants a nice little Power bonus.

name: Gobbowl Surprise
description: This Gobbowl Ball contains every Gobbowler's favourite type of candy: Gobbagum! It's so stretchy and sticky that you can even use it to glue on a broken tooth at the end of a rough match. Quick, open it up! Which flavour did you get?

name: Weapon Skill Scroll
description: Use this scroll to learn the "Weapon Skill" spell.

name: Sautéed Alchimera Flesh
description: Each piece of meat in this sauté tastes different, which makes it very popular with ladies who never know what to order in restaurants.

name: Sautéed Nileza Flesh
description: This withered meat in this sauté looks like a rat that drowned in a jar of formaldehyde. Fortunately, it tastes much better than it looks.

name: Stewed Armarine Meatballs
description: Served cold, these meatballs melt in the mouth, releasing a pleasant sensation of freshness, quickly followed by a complete numbing of the tongue and lower jaw. Serve them to your mother-in-law for a blissful afternoon of peace and quiet.

name: Missiz Freezz's Stewed Meatballs
description: By serving these meatballs to their menfolk, the women of Frigost can finally get their revenge. Once released into the mouth, the millions of tiny organisms they contain will never be able to reach their true destination.

name: Leatherbod Sole Goulash
description: Despite being stewed for hours, this meat is as tough and chewy as it was when you first picked it up. You can't cut it with a knife or bite it with your teeth, so you may as well turn it into armour.

name: Klime Sole Goulash
description: The Klime Sole in this dish is what gives it the flavour. It's probably best not to serve it to Iops, or you'll find them using it as a bungee rope, no matter how many times you tell them to stop playing with their food.

name: Mechaniac Meat Tenderloin
description: You can now eat this meat without having to equip a set of stainless steel dentures first.

name: Sylargh Meat Tenderloin
description: This meat was wrapped up in a dirty handkerchief, and has a unique flavour as a result. It reminds you of that basic survival class you took, when you were taught to find sustenance in the pickings from your nose.

name: Minced Sinistro Breast
description: This gustatory delight would tickle the tastebuds of the god Xelor himself, if only he'd sit down for a few moments and have something to eat. There are some words on the back: "Warning, may contain small pieces of clockwork" and "Not suitable for children under 12 years of age".

name: Minced Harebourg Breast
description: Nothing else in the World of Twelve tastes quite like this. Nido, the Meridia of Gastronomy, took more than a century to perfect the recipe.

name: Klime and Punishment
description: The humble story of a Frigostian shoemaker.

name: Bottle of Cocalane
description: This drink is good for curing stomach aches and headaches. It can also be used to clean mechanical drills, unclog the engines of Frigostian Carriers, dissolve any Chafers you may have rattling around in your closet, or as a colonic for the Yech'Ti.

name: Lost Towel
description: It's unlikely that the skidmarks on this towel come from the wheels of a Dragokart. The clue's in the smell, basically.

name: Nose Hair G-String
description: This g-string, made from genuine nasal hair, will protect you from the many parasites that can be found in those darker places that are dedicated to debauchery and decadence. Make no mistake, this is a top quality undergarment, and its owner would be delighted to have it back.

name: Old Magazine
description: This is an old copy of Nowt magazine, and now you just need to find someone who's interested in reading such a rag.

name: Patent of Nobility
description: This letter, sent to a resident of Castle Harebourg, never reached its owner. The postman who was supposed to deliver it no doubt ended his days as a lightshade, a frozen meal, or a stuffed blow-up doll. Still, he brought more happiness dead than he ever did alive.

name: Emote Scroll: Spyglass
description: Use this scroll to learn the Spyglass emote. Whether you're mad about Olvido or more Malava's kind of adventurer, you'll always be leagues ahead of your enemies with one eye on the horizon.

name: The Folkloric Chronicles of Anne Thrope-Oloji
description: The must-have guide for anyone who loves a party!

name: Retsej Fountain Water
description: According to an old wives' tale, anyone who drinks this water will feel obliged to reveal a terrible secret on the town square, in front of everyone. Luckily for you, the refreshing droplets in this flask have been diluted with Crocodyl Tears. Nobody will have to know what you did last summer.

name: Alliance Renaming Potion
description: "The Lumberjacks of the Apocalypse" was an amusing alliance name when you were fifteen and dreamed of being a lumberjack. But it hasn't been much help in your romantic life, nor in recruiting other members. Give your alliance a new name and imagine a new life!

name: Alliance Emblem Change Potion
description: It seemed like a good idea at the time, but face it: nobody can tell that your emblem is supposed to be an emancipated Bwork hunting down his own parents to make a statement about freedom. Nobody. Do the world a favour and change that awful emblem now!

name: Necessary Alliance Prism
description: This magical item is the gentleman's (and gentlelady's) way to mark one's territory. It should be used to excess by all those who conquer to pass the time.

name: Black Gobbly Summoning Fairywork
description: At every party, there comes a time when you desperately want to play Leap-Gobbly. This Fairywork will get your friends in the mood for a game too!

name: White Gobbly Summoning Fairywork
description: At every party, there comes a time when you desperately want to play Leap-Gobbly. This Fairywork will get your friends in the mood for a game too!

name: Midgie Summoning Fairywork
description: Astonishing! You feel as though you're in a Gobball pen, just without the Gobballs!

name: Starry Fairywork
description: If you're looking to keep your feet on the ground, this Fairywork will be no help at all.

name: Acorntastic Fairywork
description: This Fairywork is especially popular with Boars, who set them off in great number during all kinds of celebrations, and then scurry off into the grass to truffle around for the fallen treats.

name: Brief Fairywork
description: The best Fairywork on earth for celebrating Captain Chafer's Panty Party.

name: Lazy Fairywork
description: A Fairywork in memory of the night when Sadida got so sick of lying in bed, wide-awake, that he got up and switched off all the stars.

name: Wealthy Fairywork
description: Use with caution: in some areas, using it can be interpreted as a provocation.

name: Musical Fairywork
description: This Fairywork sounds nice the first time you hear it, but once you've heard 10,000 of them in a row to celebrate Gobbstock, the novelty kind of wears off.

name: Mush Mush Fairywork
description: This Fairywork is rarely used, because it gives off a distinctive, pestilent odour. Still, it's always a good idea to have a few on you, to cover up all those... embarrassing moments.

name: Cawwot Fairywork
description: This Fairywork will put stars in your friends' eyes. Tonight, Matthew, I'm going to be... A Wabbit!

name: Flowery Fairywork
description: A Demonic Rose explodes over everyone's heads. Biological warfare has never been so pretty.

name: Sentinel Potion
description: When you drink this potion, you'll fly into such a rage that any enemies that get any closer than 6 cells away will find themselves automatically attacked.

name: Count Harebourg
description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.

name: Count Frigost
description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.

name: Undertaker Potion
description: When leaving your enemy as quiet as the grave isn't enough for you, use this potion to send his soul straight to the cemetery without passing go.

name: Healer Potion
description: You were supposed to protect that adventurer, but you failed miserably. Heigh-ho, you can always use this potion to revive them and save them a trip to the cemetery.

name: Alliance Temple Potion
description: With this potion, you can teleport straight to the Alliance Temple. Now you've got no excuse for finding yourself all alone without a role whilst the battle is raging!

name: Arachnee Summoning Fairywork
description: Here's a Fairywork for the Arachneephobe in you. What could be more soothing than seeing a nasty Arachnee projected into the air and blown to pieces?

name: Cloudy Fairywork
description: The Rogues know how to use this Fairywork better than anyone. Spectacular vanishing acts guaranteed!

name: Mimisymbic
description: This shape-shifting creature absorbs the appearance of the only meal it has in its life before forming a fusional symbiotic relationship with a host item of the same type. When the Mimisymbic is removed from its host by force, it loses its adhesive powers and shrivels up into a sad little ball of no use to anyone. Awww.

name: Wotten Cawwot
description: Wabbits are wotten... er, rotten... at spelling, as the name of this veggie demonstrates. You're so disgusted at this wanton replacement of one letter by another that the mere sight of this Cawwot makes you want to puke. Just as well, because it's past its prime.

name: Cawwocola
description: The Cawwot soda that flows so freely in Gwimace's restaurants has all the same benefits as other sodas: high sugar and calorie content, brief impression of refreshment and hydration, increased risk of diabetes and cardiovascular disease, and decreased life expectancy. However, it also has something the others don't: Cawwocola teleports you straight to Isle of the Cwown!

name: Teleportation Module
description: With this module, you'll be able to upgrade your alliance prism so it can teleport characters to other controlled prisms or Zaaps.

name: Incredible Perceptor Potion
description: Use this potion to summon a Perceptor.

name: Fattumy Potion
description: This potion tastes good, like lemonade! Unlike lemonade, it will teleport you straight to Fattumy's Inn. Only works in Incarnam. Definitely doesn't work in the depths of a dungeon or on dark and stormy nights. Fattumy won't be there to take care of you forever, you know!

name: Emote Scroll: Give a Cake
description: This scroll will allow you to learn the Give a Cake emote. It's a deliciously kind thought that will charm even the sourest Mama Bwork.

name: Captain Amakna
description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.

name: Merkator
description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.

name: Emote Scroll: Boo
description: Use this scroll to learn the Boo emote.

name: Emote Scroll: Big Wave
description: Use this scroll to learn the Big Wave emote.

name: Emote Scroll: Boxer
description: Use this scroll to learn the Boxer emote.

name: Emote Scroll: Wave the White Flag
description: Use this scroll to learn the Wave the White Flag emote.

name: Emote Scroll: Spitfire
description: Use this scroll to learn the Spitfire emote.

name: Alchemist's Journal - First Notebook
description: This manuscript is said to have been written a long, long time ago by Ereziah Melkewel, one of the most powerful Alchemists in the World of Twelve.

name: Alchemist's Journal - Second Notebook
description: The next journal kept by Ereziah Melkewel. Reading it would probably be instructive.

name: Hall of Infamy
description: This copious compilation of crooks could serve as a guide to people you don't want to meet, and can do double duty as a disciplinary tool for kids: "If you don't behave, the guy on page 6 will come and get you!" Other uses include doorstop, hammer, firestarter, and we reckon it'd make a decent murder weapon.

name: Krobax
description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.

description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.

description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.

name: Lou
description: Use this figurine to add it directly to your collection of Krosmaster figurines.

name: Kanig Rump Supreme
description: One mouthful of this Rump Supreme is quite enough, thank you!

name: Smoked Kanigrula Breast
description: The question is not whether to have breast or thigh. The question is what wine does one serve to accompany them?

name: Roast Strich Fillet
description: A fillet just oozing with meaty juices - perfect for a low-fat, high-protein dinner. If you have a Trool friend coming round to eat, he'd probably prefer that weirdo you met at the inn the other night, who's richer in fats and alcohol.

name: Roast Cross Strich Fillet
description: Given the number of times the Cross Strich handed you your arse on a plate, you can't help but grin as your prepare to tuck into this roast dinner with gusto.

name: Stagecoach Potion
description: This potion will teleport its drinker to the stagecoach station in Astrub. Fresh mint has been added to mask the smell of dead rat, but the taste remains unchanged. Drink it the moment you wake up - that way, nobody will even notice.

name: Emote Scroll: Hands Behind Back
description: Use this scroll to learn the Hands Behind Back emote.

name: Emote Scroll: Open a Pocket Portal
description: Use this scroll to learn the Open a Pocket Portal emote.

name: Emote Scroll: Locate a Portal
description: Use this scroll to learn the Locate a Portal emote.

name: Antrezure Eidolonic Veil
description: Always dreamt of looking like an Antrezure? Now, thanks to state-of-the-art advances in dimensional technomagic, YOU CAN!

name: Powa Drhell Eidolonic Veil
description: Always dreamt of looking like a Powa Drhell? Now, thanks to state-of-the-art advances in dimensional technomagic, YOU CAN!

name: Levitrof Eidolonic Veil
description: Always dreamt of looking like a Levitrof? Now, thanks to state-of-the-art advances in dimensional technomagic, YOU CAN!

name: Kamasterisk Eidolonic Veil
description: Always dreamt of looking like a Kamasterisk? Now, thanks to state-of-the-art advances in dimensional technomagic, YOU CAN!

name: Emote Scroll: Magnifying Glass
description: Use this scroll to learn the Magnifying Glass emote.

name: Emote Scroll: Beg
description: Use this scroll to learn the Beg emote.

name: Emote Scroll: Hit Your Forehead
description: Use this scroll to learn the Hit Your Forehead emote.

name: Emote Scroll: Look for Treasure
description: Use this scroll to learn the Look for Treasure emote.

name: Treasure Hunter Potion
description: The instructions are clear enough... Empty the contents into exactly the right geyser on Frigost Island to create a rainbow whose opposite end may well indicate the location of a hypothetical buried treasure which may or may not have already been found. The potion's secondary use is as a drink which will teleport you to the treasure hunt building.

name: Dimensional Voyager Potion
description: When you drink this potion, you'll be teleported to the portal room in the Dimensional Voyagers' Tower. If everything goes to plan, that is.

name: Emote Scroll: Greed
description: Use this scroll to learn the Enutrof class's special emote.

name: Enutough Chest
description: You ransacked the Enutoughs' land, going so far as to steal their chests. Was it really worth the risk?

name: Drheller Chest
description: You ransacked the Drhellers' land, going so far as to steal their chests. Was it really worth the risk?

name: Strongboxer Chest
description: You ransacked the Strongboxers' land, going so far as to steal their chests. Was it really worth the risk?

name: Enutrof's Stone
description: When used to make soup, this divine stone will make you a divine prospector... For a while, at least.

name: Totankama's Chest
description: This chest contains Totankama's legendary treasure. What's inside? Open it and find out! You don't believe in curses, right? Good.

name: Gein's Chest
description: It's hard to know if this is really Gein's chest. Maybe it's Gein's Double's chest's double.

name: Stellia's Chest
description: Stellia might hide her puppets in it. Or her clubs.

name: Blundergus Eidolonic Veil
description: Have you always dreamed of looking like a Blundergus? Now, with the power of dimensional technomagic, it's possible!

name: Trechepeira Eidolonic Veil
description: Have you always dreamed of looking like a Trechepeira? Now, with the power of dimensional technomagic, it's possible!

name: Terristocrat Eidolonic Veil
description: Have you always dreamed of looking like a Terristocrat? Now, with the power of dimensional technomagic, it's possible!

name: Tortryck Eidolonic Veil
description: Have you always dreamed of looking like a Tortryck? Now, with the power of dimensional technomagic, it's possible!

name: Apisaph's Potion
description: Drink this potion to be transported to Minotoror Island, to the Sanctuary of a Hundred Detours. Warning: only functions if you have already met Apisaph.

name: Dremoan Chest
description: This chest smells heavily of fungus. Maybe it's actually a shoe box.

name: Dark Court Chest
description: You ransacked the Dark Court's land, going so far as to steal their chests. Was it really worth the risk?

name: Necrotick Chest
description: You ransacked the Necrotick's land, going so far as to steal their chests. Was it really worth the risk?

name: Malitiamen Chest
description: You ransacked the Malitiamen's land, going so far as to steal their chests. Was it really worth the risk?

name: Mastigator's Chest
description: This chest was hermetically sealed to be resistant to your Corcodyl tears.

name: Inisignificant Box of Fragments
description: This box contains one or several map fragments. If you don't know how to read a map, you can resell them to adventurers who are a bit more clever.

name: Rusty Box of Fragments
description: This box contains one or several map fragments. If you don't know how to read a map, you can resell them to adventurers who are a bit more clever.

name: Magistral Box of Fragments
description: This box contains one or several map fragments. If you don't know how to read a map, you can resell them to adventurers who are a bit more clever.

name: Torturer's Beer
description: There was a time when this strong beer was served to prisoners condemned to death. Every so often, the beer alone was enough to do the trick.

name: Sram's Phalanges
description: Dissolved in vinegar or some bad wine, this bony finger will make you more treacherous than you've ever been... temporarily, at least.

name: Emote Scroll: Explosive
description: This scroll lets you learn the special Rogue class emote.

name: Elfacet Eidolonic Veil
description: Always dreamt of looking like an Elfacet? Now, thanks to state-of-the-art advances in technomagic, YOU CAN!

name: Twentoo Eidolonic Veil
description: Always dreamt of looking like a Twentoo? Now, thanks to state-of-the-art advances in technomagic, YOU CAN!

name: Hystairkal Eidolonic Veil
description: Always dreamt of looking like a Hystairkal? Now, thanks to state-of-the-art advances in technomagic, YOU CAN!

name: Ickyrus Eidolonic Veil
description: Always dreamt of looking like an Ickyrus? Now, thanks to state-of-the-art advances in technomagic, YOU CAN!

name: Emote Scroll: Whistle
description: Use this scroll to learn the Whistle emote.

name: Dance
description: Use this scroll to learn the Dance emote.

name: Emote Scroll: Kamarena
description: Use this scroll to learn the Kamarena emote.

name: Akornaddikt's Chest
description: This is where Akornaddikt stores his acorns for winter. Only touch it if you're ready to face his squirrely wrath!

name: Watch Running Slow
description: With this watch, you can continue to live in the past. Don't forget to pepper your speech with interjections of "Things were so much better in my day!"

name: Watch Running Fast
description: With this watch, you can become eternally insatiable, always in a hurry to see what life will throw at you next.

name: Xelor's Sand
description: A pinch of Xelor's Sand in your morning coffee won't prevent you from being late, but it will make you a little smarter... only temporarily, of course.

name: Xelomorph Chest
description: This chest materialised as a result of the perfect synchronisation of Xelorium's spacetime continuum.

name: Altdemon Chest
description: This chest materialised as a result of the perfect synchronisation of Xelorium's spacetime continuum.

name: Fugitive Chest
description: This chest materialised as a result of the perfect synchronisation of Xelorium's spacetime continuum.

name: Emote Scroll: Timeless
description: Use this scroll to learn the Xelor class's special emote.

name: Scampihorse's Chest
description: This chest contains the treasures of all the pirates who took their loot with them to their watery graves.

name: Panthyrozy's Chest
description: This perfumed chest won't leave you cold.

name: Brumen's Chest
description: This chest contains many ointments that can be used to heal people.

name: Emote Scroll: Transcendent
description: Use this scroll to learn the Eliotrope class's special emote.

name: Eliotrope Elixir
description: A good slug of this and you'll be teleported to the Eliotrope Temple. Known side effects: hiccups, apparition of in-laws, hair loss, dog breath, untied shoelaces, successive red traffic lights.

name: Eliotrope's Portal
description: Information about Eliotropes.

name: Class Change Potion
description: You can use this potion to change class.

name: Emote Scroll: Bolgrot's Wrath
description: Use this scroll to learn the Bolgrot's Wrath emote.

name: Coloured Fairywork
description: This Fairywork is popular when celebrating the arrival of spring. Caution: Inhaling the powder has been known to create psychedelic hallucinations as powerful as the Fairywork itself.

name: Emote Scroll: Steamy
description: Use this scroll to learn the Foggernaut class's special emote.

name: Droid Potion
description: After having drunk it, you'll talk in metallic noises and punctuate your sentences with beeps and whistles.

name: Raid Mohr Potion
description: The ads for this potion assure you that it's capable of waking the dead. But they don't mention what happens when you spray it on the living...

name: Divination Potion
description: The Xelor lobby is trying to outlaw the sale of this potion based on a whole bunch of made-up pretexts, simply because it threatens their monopoly. Any resemblance to any or all existing lobbies is purely coincidental.

name: Rad Dit Potion
description: This potion was invented by an alchemist who wanted to keep the uneducated away from his creations. It had the opposite effect though - it draw the attention of many Astrubians.

name: Field Potion
description: Ecaflips appreciate that this potion lets them tempt fate with a stroke of luck.

name: Praying Potion
description: This potion is served to the city's condemned just before their decapitation.

name: Pythag Potion
description: Creators abuse this potion when they're short on ideas.

name: Margedelweiss Potion
description: Alchemists sell the Margedelweiss Potion as a Dofus detector. Of course, Astrubians have cleaned out the stock.

name: Judj Raid Potion
description: Is justice immutable in your eyes? Are you the victim of a hasty condemnation you couldn't contest? This potion will get you back on your feet and continuing your misdeeds discreetly.

name: Trool's Blood
description: An alchemist wanted to reproduce Trools' ability to regenerate. Since taking blood from the source seemed to miss the point, the alchemist decided to synthesize it instead.

name: Tri Potion
description: Pandawas look down on the exportation of this non-alcoholic potion.

name: Raid Mption Potion
description: For the dead who aren't quite dead, and still have a lot to make up for.

name: Goku Potion
description: This potion won't make you a super warrior. Reported side-effects include: hairy tails, primate transformation.

name: Raid Izded Potion
description: According to some rumours, Emile is the killer. This potion was created to give the victims a second chance.

name: Tear of Eniripsa
description: The tears of the Goddess are rumoured to heal many injuries, but that doesn't explain why her disciples are such wimpy crybabies.

name: Donzel Potion
description: Used as a lotion, it will make you young and pretty, even if you're a man.

name: Revitalizing Potion
description: This potion is great for getting the injured back on their feet and out massacring innocent creatures.

name: Cheesemonger Potion
description: The mould in this potion is not hazardous to your health - so long as you're already dead.

name: White Bread
description: The minstrel Davyd created this bread for people who, like him, don't mince words.

name: Gingerbread
description: This bread gets its name from the way it's prepared, namely by a red-headed baker named Matthew.

name: Waffle
description: This waffle is a particular favourite of many politicians. The most interesting thing is what you put on it.

name: Golden Waffle
description: This cake first appeared in Astrub. Since then, it's become quite popular and can be found near Zaaps and in the marketplaces of numerous cities.

name: Faluche
description: Trools have a tendency to confuse this bread with a hat. No one's quite certain why.

name: Burnet
description: The Bearman himself perfected the recipe of this bread, inspired by a particularly bad bout of indigestion.

name: Tortilla
description: One thing you've got to remember: tortillas are like pies – they've better well-filled.

name: Burrito
description: This dish used to be quite popular at drinking parties on the coral beach.

name: Fouace
description: It's like a pita, only not.

name: Rotisserie Eel
description: Here's a fish that will never again try to slip out of your hands.

name: Rotisserie Rock Eel
description: A favourite amongst paranoids, investigators, and tax inspectors.

name: Baked Sea Bream
description: Revenge is a dish best served cold. Or like this.

name: Baked Royal Sea Bream
description: Royal revenge is a dish best served cold. Or like this.

name: Monkfish Salad
description: When it's cooked this way, this fish reminds you of the feast the Kanniballs organised when your grandfather passed away.

name: Humonkfish Salad
description: Butchers look poorly on this competing salad being on the market.

name: Cod Stew
description: The Kanniballs created this recipe, but since their diet is frowned upon in Allister's kingdom, Amaknians have adapted it with fish.

name: Bearded Cod Stew
description: This deluxe dish is only available from Kanniball chefs because of the rarity of Bearded Cod.

name: Tench Matelote
description: During difficult fights, imagine your teammates in the place of this fish.

name: Haunted Tench Matelote
description: You're quaking with fear at the idea that this fish could be a reincarnated teammate.

name: Panned Swordfish
description: If you play with fire too much, you'll get burned. A lesson that's just a bit too late for this fish.

name: Panned Quixote Swordfish
description: This fish's dreams of grandeur led it all the way to this plate.

name: Sack of Ginseng
description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Ginseng.

name: Sack of Belladonna
description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Belladonna.

name: Sack of Mandrake
description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Mandrake.

name: Sack of Hazel Wood
description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Hazel Wood.

name: Sack of Corn
description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Corn.

name: Sack of Millet
description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Millet.

name: Sack of Eels
description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Eels.

name: Sack of Sea Bream
description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Sea Bream.

name: Sack of Monkfish
description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Monkfish.

name: Sack of Cod
description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Cod.

name: Sack of Tench
description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Tench.

name: Sack of Swordfish
description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Swordfish.

name: Flesh Bullion
description: This insipid dish is part of the traditional Incarnam cuisine.

name: Famished Sunflower Soup
description: Ronan the Barbarian's mother frequently told him to drink his soup to become big. One can guess that he must not have ever listened.

name: Beach Sweet
description: Contrary to what any Iops might have told you, you can actually eat this anywhere, not just the beach.

name: Sponge Mob Sweet
description: The method of preparing this meat before cooking it in paper guarantees an inimitable taste.

name: Batofu Beignet
description: This beignet, adored by Rekojeht, makes a disturbing smile play across his lips every time he has one.

name: Field Pan Fry
description: It will have you dancing in the fields, if you weren't already. Admit it. You were.

name: Treechnidian Round in Pepper Sauce
description: Children prefer food that is simple, fatty, sugary or salty to fancy food and peppers.

name: Golden Scarabugly Ball
description: This ball shines more than the ones you make with your boogers, but rest assured, it's harder to flick with your fingers.

name: Vilinsekt Grillade
description: The best thing about this meat isn't the taste, but the noise the Vilinsekt makes when it's cooked.

name: Kickroach Grillade
description: Thankfully, Kickroach is impossible to hear, because the obscenities that it shouted while being cooked would make even a Rogue blush.

name: Onion-Flavoured Marrow Bone
description: It doesn't matter where you get the onions - what matters is that you get them.

name: Onion-Flavoured Ronin Chafer Marrow Bone
description: This dish gives off an odour strangely similar to your breath when you wake up, which is why cooks often use it to keep stray cats away.

name: Blop Bullion
description: Since there are idiots everywhere for whom common sense is nothing but a legend, this dish comes with the notice: "Do not consume while burning - risk of serious burn."

name: Salted Shin Larva
description: This off-white, aniseed-flavoured liquid squirting into your mouth when you bite into this larva reminds you of certain drunken nights.

name: Bandit Cottage Pie
description: Accompanied by potatoes, this dish is perfect for getting Bandits ready for their future stays in Brakmar jails.

name: Smiths' Chest Cottage Pie
description: Accompanied by potato peels, this dish is perfect for getting Bandits ready for their future stays in Brakmar jails.

name: Bwork Andouillette
description: Not knowing what to do with their tripe, the Bworks decided to eat it to give them courage.

name: Bworkette Andouillette
description: After eating this dish, your breath will be able to kill a Bwork.

name: Ashy Coral
description: A hole in the sand, a fire on the beach, food rolled in ash and everything's taken care of. The hardest part is getting a Coralator to participate.

name: Ashy Great Coral
description: A hole in the sand, a fire on the beach, food rolled in ash and everything's taken care of. The hardest part is getting the Great Coralator out of his grotto.

name: Ash-Coated Bulb Tart
description: Less violent than the last time you took a pie to the kisser, this pie is also lighter.

name: Ash-Coated Bulbig Brotha Tart
description: A Pandawa custom says the Bulbig Brotha Tart should be shared with your family.

name: Blop Marinade
description: This is what happens when a Blop drowns.

name: Royal Blop Marinade
description: This is what happens when a Royal Blop tries to learn to swim.

name: Spiced Jelly
description: This fatty, sugary, and salty mixture is recommended if you're managing bad cholesterol, diabetes, or gout.

name: Spiced Royal Jelly
description: This fatty, sugary, and salty mixture is recommended if you want bad cholesterol, diabetes, or gout.

name: Boiled Turtle
description: I LIKE TURTLES!

name: Kanniball Andouillette
description: Sometimes, a Kanniball's rite of passage ceremony goes very wrong, much to the delight of their peers.

name: Kanniball Andchain Andouillette
description: When the Kanniball chief is no longer fit to rule, he's divided among the members of his tribe. The one that accidentally stabs their palate with a bone while eating the old chief becomes the new one.

name: Axle Wose Potion
description: This potion won't make you more attractive, but it might make your hair grow.

name: Country Rat Jowl
description: Believing that a farmer had been used as the basis of this dish, a Iop knight decided to avenge his death. Which explains the decided lack of rats in the fields.

name: Steamed Ethereal Tripe
description: There is only one way to cook this dish, which makes the sight of it all the more unsettling.

name: Steamed Shiny Ethereal Tripe
description: There is only one way to cook this dish, which makes the sight of it in the dark possible.

name: Crackler Bullion
description: The advantage of Crackler Bullion is that it can be directly cooked on a stone, giving a smooth and even broth.

name: Legendary Crackler Bullion
description: Drinking this bullion won't make you a legend, but you'll avoid dying of hunger and thirst, and hey, that's a start.

name: Grilled Marrow Bone
description: There's not a lot there to eat, but one single mouthful will be enough to send you to Ingloriom.

name: Grilled Gourlo the Terrible Marrow Bone
description: There's not a lot there to eat, but one single mouthful will be enough to send you to the Shustuft Crust.

name: Smoked Wa Wobot Jowl
description: Along with a glass of cawwot juice, this dish is positively regal.

name: Kitsou Offal Lemonade
description: The acidity of the lemon offsets the high PH of the offal, which almost makes it edible.

name: Daggero Offal Lemonade
description: The acidity of the lemon offsets the high PH of the offal, which almost makes it good.

name: Brain Salad
description: For a moment, you wonder if it's the remains of last night's vomit, then you remember that your Bow Wow already took care of that mess for you.

name: Dark Vlad Brain Salad
description: You're too hungry to ask yourself if this is leftovers of last night's vomit.

name: Vegetarian Stir Fry
description: Frying makes up for the lack of fat in vegetarian dishes.

name: Dark Treechnidian Round Grillade
description: This savoury dish will make vegetarians as happy as carnivores.

name: Ancestral Treechnid Round Grillade
description: Butchers refuse to taste this food because they worry they'll be turned into a Treechnid.

name: Arak-hai Terrine in Jelly
description: The less you know about this terrine, the better.

name: Rac Queen Terrine in Jelly
description: Theoretically, cooking this dish will have killed the Arak-hai eggs. If not, you'll soon have a lot more children to take care of.

name: Boiled Marrow Bone
description: It's not advisable to drink the juice that accompanies this dish, unless you want to have a shape similar to a Pandora.

name: Boiled LeChouque Marrow Bone
description: This dish is so ridiculously small that it would only satisfy a Vilinsekt.

name: Exotic Salad
description: A culinary specialty of Moon Island, this recipe disappeared after the arrival of the Kanniballs.

name: Exotic Brain Salad
description: Since they arrived on Moon Island, the Kanniballs have adapted the recipe of this exotic salad.

name: Krtek Cottage Pie
description: To appreciate the true value of this dish, you must add Apis and dirt. Or at least, that's the way Iops explain it.

name: Braised Gobball
description: The taste of this meat will be worth the twelve hours you'll have to wait for it to cook.

name: Braised Koolich
description: Obviously, it's not the actual Koolich, because you'd have to cut down every tree in Amakna just to cook it.

name: Krismahlo Pemmican
description: This meat can keep for decades without its taste or nutritional qualities changing.

name: Puppet Master Pemmican
description: Giles Verne advises Foggernauts to take this meat with them on all their long trips.

name: Spiced Strongboxer
description: It takes a lot of spice to mask the metallic taste of this dish.

name: Spiced Brutatax
description: The spices accentuate the auriferous taste of this dish, which should satisfy the greediest Enutrof.

name: Stuffed Ouassinge Stomach
description: The stuffing is comprised of everything the Ouassinge absorbed before dying. With luck, there are even some edible parts.

name: Rat Jowl Stew
description: It's not a bad idea to eat before combat in order to excuse your inefficiency.

name: Black Rat Jowl Stew
description: Only hardened Brakmarians are able to swallow this meat without belching flames. So Oto Mustam deliberately distributed it to young recruits during important battles.

name: White Rat Jowl Stew
description: Notable Bontarians eat this dish with an infamous taste in order to seem different and show they're not like everyone else - and, indeed, no one else eats it.

name: Herb-Rubbed Sirloin Steak Salad
description: Otomai's disciples adore consuming anything made from alcohol or herbs, which led them to create this recipe.

name: Silf the Greater Bherb Sirloin Steak Salad
description: It's well known that eat Silf the Greater Bherb accompanied by cocktails loosens tongues. Certain of Otomai's more unscrupulous disciples have even used this fact to obtain information about the Turquoise Dofus.

name: Baked Crobak Liver Paté
description: Many chefs have tried to reproduce this recipe by putting common Crobaks directly in the oven, but without success.

name: Baked Lord Crow Liver Paté
description: Not everyone can cook this meat, and even fewer can pay for it.

name: Koalak Sausage
description: It's slightly more effective for digging a small hole than being used as food.

name: Skeunk Sausage
description: This pudding has a pretty bad taste, but it's still popular with Astrubian youths.

name: Royal Rainbow Blop Marinade
description: This is what happens when a Royal Rainbow Blop confuses a plate with its bathtub.

name: Minos Hock Stew
description: From now on, you'll be able to draw the Minotoror's labyrinth in your plate.

name: Mintoror Hock Stew
description: Whatever the Minotoror was plotting doesn't matter now that it's in your plate.

name: Tofu Strip Pan Fry
description: Tastes like Tofu.

name: Royal Tofu Strip Pan Fry
description: Not everyone gets a chance to taste this royal dish.

name: Pandissident Liver Salad
description: This balanced dish comes with it's own drink to accompany it.

name: Pandora Master Liver Salad
description: Consumed in excess, this salad quickly goes to the head, and will make you do inadmissible things, like vomiting in your boots, or worse, your neighbours'.

name: Grilled Xelomorph Pie
description: This pie has a more regular shape than the "pies" your mount creates.

name: Grilled Fraktal Pie
description: Some prefer it square, some like it triangular, and the worst are those that refuse to eat it if it's not shaped like jigsaw pieces.

name: Zoth Sausage
description: Each year, the stupidest Zoths get together at the Zaap to compare the length of their sausages. The longest gets the honour of being revered as a god by his peers.

name: Tanukouï San Breast in Jelly
description: No matter what you've been told, jelly will never replace real fresh meat.

name: Marinated Malitiaman Flank
description: The original recipe used water from the Shrouded Canals for the marinade, but most tourists couldn't handle it and ended up in the Os-Piss.

name: Marinated Captain Scarlight Flank
description: Much progress has been made recently in the treatment of the Shrouded Canals water used for the marinade, which has reduced the number of consumer deaths by an order of magnitude.

name: Firefoux Roulade
description: Everyone has their own special way of preparing this dish: rolling it in their armpits, mud, or, rarely, flour.

name: Peki Peki Roulade
description: Few cooks dare prepare this dish - not because it's difficult to prepare, but because collecting the ingredients can be fatal.

name: Sautéed Short-Tempered Treechnidian Round
description: How short-tempered can it be after having been sautéed? Apparently, the answer is: very.

name: Sautéed Soft Oak Round
description: You'll be able to invite your in-laws to dinner without them thinking you're trying to poison them.

name: Rotisserie Fleurizome Round
description: This 100% vegetarian round should be served just barely cooked.

name: Rotisserie Tynril Round
description: If you eat it, you'll feel better.

name: Diced Amakna Rat Jowl
description: If, after throwing one of these six-sided die, you get an eight, you've probably spent too much time on Nolifis Island.

name: Diced Sphincter Cell Jowl
description: This dish has a slight taste of sausage pizza.

name: Breaded Ectoplasmic Meat
description: This meat is served to adventurers who want to brave the ocean's fury without ever leaving the Gobball fields.

name: Breaded Buck Anear Meat
description: Be careful Buck Anear doesn't come to take this piece of meat back from your stomach.

name: Spiced Drheller Muzzle
description: If you'd like to live a long, healthy life, avoid inviting Enutoughs to share this meal with you.

name: Spiced Drhossil Muzzle
description: When Dhyan Fossi asked you to calm the Drhossil down, she never suspected you'd use such cruel methods.

name: Minotot Hock Stew
description: When you think of all the slaves dying of starvation every day in the Stontusk Desert, you'll be more appreciative of this dish's taste.

name: Sym Filet
description: Not to be confused with Sim, an old Enutrof whose as funny as your Dad's jokes...

name: Kimbo Filet
description: The rules of gastronomy say this meat should be eaten cooked every other day, and raw the days in between.

name: Toadorous Terrine
description: No one is singing the praises of this terrine.

name: Obsidemon Terrine
description: There's always a small risk of breaking a tooth while eating this terrine.

name: Stuffed Giant Kralove Stomach
description: The stuffing is easy to prepare: you just need to gather the remains of several adventures who failed to defeat the Giant Kralove.

name: Fuji Snowfoux Steak
description: This steak gives off an intoxicating perfumed odour which awakens males' reproductive instinct, and repels females.

name: Altdemon Pudding
description: No matter what it's made of, puddings remain a favourite dish of Twelvians.

name: XLII Sausage
description: This long and large sausage will fill with pleasure those lucky enough to get a taste.

name: Bwork Laap
description: Serving this meat cooked instead of raw is a sacrilege which should be punished with being drowned in cheap wine.

name: Bworker Laap
description: As you may have heard, the longer it is, the less short it is.

name: Fried Mushrooms
description: These mushrooms will help you understand everything.

name: Fried Ougaa Mushrooms
description: Frying is the only cooking method known to inhibit the deadly substances found in these mushrooms. And that means that all the other methods had to be tested before they were known not to work.

name: Vegetarian Plate
description: This dish, targeted at tourists, is but a pale and cheap imitation of the famous salad with Rattedaugue vinaigrette.

name: Vegetarian Plate with Korriander
description: This dish was developed for consumers whose palates couldn't handle a salad dressed with Rattedaugue vinaigrette.

name: Necrotick Ball
description: This ball has the consistency and flavour of an old booger.

name: Toxoliath Ball
description: This ball has the consistency and flavour of an old Trool booger.

name: Sakaian Salad
description: The nicest thing you can say about this dish is that it looks a lot better than it tastes.

name: Grohlum Sakaian Salad
description: Grohlum is a heavyweight, everyone knows that. This salad is no exception, and only the most solid stomachs can digest it without flinching.

name: Kolosso Flank Steak with Cream
description: Used correctly, this steak can be used as a weapon or projectile during protests.

name: Obscurantus Leg
description: Despite its imposing size, this leg has negative calories. So you can munch on it all day without gaining a kilopod. But really, would you want to?

name: Shadow Leg
description: After eating this leg, you'll feel an emptiness in your stomach. Which is why eating it is forbidden during most eating contests.

name: Diced Meat in Jelly
description: These dice are great for playing silently, even when the only surface available is a glass or marble table.

name: Diced Merkator Meat in Jelly
description: If your players have the annoying habit of throwing their dice at you when you ask them to roll them, give them these dice instead. Not only will you be able to finish your games relatively bruise-free, you won't be hungry.

name: Molecular Krobe Egg
description: Straight out of a horror show, this gelatinous fake egg has no chance of passing for a Dofus.

name: Molecular Protoz'orror Egg
description: This is the absolute latest in modern light cooking: an empty plate to keep you from gaining weight, and an exorbitant price to help your purse with the same thing.

name: Enutough Jelly
description: This dish was created for folks whose teeth have long been lost to the ravages of time and become a part of the fossil record.

name: Nidas Jelly
description: They don't serve just anything at the King's table, nor just anyONE.

name: Dark Court Pasties
description: In Srambad, they quickly ran into problems with storing bodies. A brilliant solution allows them to simultaneously solve the problem of having too many mouths to feed...

name: Queen of Thieves Pasties
description: Don't think that the Queen of Thieves would be a simple mouthful - that would be underestimating her.

name: Fugitive Eggplant Quenelle
description: This recipe was invented by Two-Fingers when he tried out cooking. He never imagined that it would be so popular with the Astrubian populace.

name: Vortex Eggplant Quenelle
description: Anyone possessing this Quenelle risks being stopped by the Order Errant.

description: This bag contains several aubergines.

description: This bag contains several Eternal Ashes.

description: This barrel contains several Scurvion Bloods.

name: Atolmond Beer
description: This beer helps reinforce the skull and other bones, which explains why Chafers are so headstrong.

name: Djaul Beer
description: Created for the elite Djaulian, in all ways better than common plebes, this beer makes one megalomaniacal and egocentric. Unfortunately, it doesn't make one smart.

name: Misery Beer
description: This beer is intended for those who don't have the means to get a Djaul Beer.

name: Bworkball Beer
description: The only difference between this beer and Bwork beer is the sulphurous aftertaste.

description: Unlike your sweetheart, this log is both sweet smelling and sweet tasting. Too bad it won't be more than a single mouthful.

name: Ayuto's Potion
description: Drink this potion to transport close to the workshop in the Imp Village. Note that it only works if you have Mama Ayuto's permission.

name: Emote Scroll: Salute
description: Use this scroll to learn the Salute emote.

name: Emote Scroll: Ballistic
description: Use this scroll to learn the Cra class's special emote.

name: Emote Scroll: Fisherman
description: Use this scroll to learn the Fisherman profession's special emote.

name: Emote Scroll: Parasol
description: This scroll allows you to learn the Parasol emote.

name: Fair Trade Recycler
description:
You can upgrade an alliance prism by adding this module and then extracting the magic essence of any thingamajig you want in order to craft other stuff, which you can sell for ten times the price of a whatchamacallit.
It has been set up to fairly distribute the gains between the alliance and the recycler (50% for the character and 50% for the alliance).

name: Collective Recycler
description:
You can upgrade an alliance prism by adding this module and then extracting the magic essence of any thingamajig you want in order to craft other stuff, which you can sell for ten times the price of a whatchamacallit.
It has been set up to distribute the gains in favour of the alliance (30% for the character and 90% for the alliance).

name: Meatball
description: If cooks like to keep this recipe a closely guarded secret, it's not because they're afraid of it being copied, but in case it will be brought up in court.

name: Astrubian Fritter
description: Ever popular with the kiddies, this fritter is also favoured by adults who hate knowing exactly what they're eating.

name: Fortifying Astrubian Fritter
description: As insipid as its namesake, this fritter is the recommended diet for a Iop.

name: Meat Roulade
description: This is the favourite meal of Undertakers and Goblin merchants.

name: Fortifying Meat Roulade
description: The illustrious Ronan the Barbarian rolls these himself under the armpits of his fallen foes.

name: Lemon Papillote
description: The tartness of the lemon effectively neutralises the deadly bacteria that have developed in this meat.

name: Fortifying Lemon Papillote
description: If this dish doesn't kill you, it'll only make you stronger, that's for certain.

name: Sufokian Salad
description: When the fishing's bad, Sufokians fall back on this salad, which contains all the protein they need. Just don't ask where all the protein in this salad comes from.

name: Fortified Sufokian Salad
description: The Sufokians quickly spotted that eating seafood stimulated their brains, but not their muscles. That's why they came up with this recipe.

name: Amaknian Chips
description: Gordo McRamsay himself invented this platter of greasy carbs, which soon became a staple at Amaknian festivals.

name: Fortified Amaknian Chips
description: This princely dish of devastatingly complex haute cuisine is mainly eaten by the nobility at Amaknian festivals.

name: Cottage Pie with Onion
description: If you want killer breath, look no further than this cottage pie, and eat it for every meal.

name: Fortifying Cottage Pie with Onion
description: Your breath will also be fortified after a mouthful of this rather powerful cottage pie.

name: Bontarian Terrine
description: In Brakmar, the recipe for this dish has been adapted to include genuine morsels of Bontarian Militiamen.

name: Fortifying Bontarian Terrine
description: This dish is popular with Bontarian officers who are often out in the field.

name: Tasty Goulash
description: A favourite of the people, this goulash can be whipped up using any kind of bargain-basement meat.

name: Fortifying Tasty Goulash
description: This goulash can only be created using the most rare and select of meats.

name: Countrywoman Pan Fry
description: Only women are permitted to cook this dish, which has obviously set the anti-sexist organisations by the ears.

name: Fortifying Countrywoman Pan Fry
description: Only women are allowed to eat this dish, which has obviously set the Bow Meow among the pigeons when it comes to the associations for the protection of men's rights.

name: Three-Bean Pemmican
description: The Brakmarians have hijacked the production of this dish and are now deploying the people who eat it as living bombs.

name: Fortifying Three-Bean Pemmican
description: The gastric escapes caused by the digestion of this dish are particularly explosive.

name: Brakmarian Grillade
description: The Brakmarians have adapted their cooking to fit their environment, which explains the local custom of grilling just about anything, such as roadkill, long-lost relatives, you name it.

name: Fortifying Brakmarian Grillade
description: This grillade is difficult to perfect because not every prisoner reacts in the same way to the lava bath.

name: Sweet n' Sour Marinade
description: This dish is highly prized by adventurers who haven't got time to waste on cooking a separate starter, main course and dessert.

name: Fortifying Sweet n' Sour Marinade
description: This all-in-one dish is holding its own in the stakes against energy bars.

name: Black Pudding
description: Black pudding has the reputation of being bigger, grosser, and having a more distinctive flavour than white pudding. It's also black.

name: Fortifying Black Pudding
description: Apparently black pudding is stronger than white pudding, but it's impossible to say for sure, as nobody's ever seen them arm-wrestle.

name: Spiced Stew
description: If you get into a stew when it comes to combat, you'll end up as cannon fodder.

name: Fortified Spiced Stew
description: Telling the cook they made a hash of it doesn't do justice to this dish.

name: Restorative Goulash
description: This dish is distributed in military canteens in order to maintain morale.

name: Fortifying Restorative Goulash
description: Like an extended visit from your mother-in-law, excessive consumption of this dish can cause hallucinations, depression and memory disorders.

name: Tenderloin
description: Nothing particularly interesting about this meat, but it's good stuff all the same.

name: Fortifying Tenderloin
description: It seems you can be both tender and firm, as this tenderloin demonstrates.

name: Hind's Quenelle
description: 57 varieties, all of them bland and covered in tomato sauce.

name: Fortifying Hind's Quenelle
description: They may not be any good, but they'll make you stronger if your stomach can digest them without bringing them back up.

name: Game Andouillette
description: Eat this sausage with respect, because you might find yourself in its place after the next manhunt.

name: Fortified Game Andouillette
description: The uncleansed tripe in this sausage gives this andouillette properties that are highly sought after by both adventurers and bodybuilders alike.

name: Smoked Sausage
description: Although this is less popular than the ever sought-after sausage sorbet, smoked sausage is still appreciated for the unique taste of the final mouthful.

name: Fortified Smoked Sausage
description: It's mainly due to the extreme elasticity of this shape-memory sausage that adults get told off for playing with their food.

name: Kokoko Recycler
description:
You can upgrade an alliance prism by adding this module and then extracting the magic essence of any thingamajig you want in order to craft other stuff, which you can sell for ten times the price of a whatchamacallit.
It has been set up to distribute the gains in favour of the alliance, who then share the gains fairly among the people (10% for the character and 130% for the alliance).

name: Bow Meow Emoticons
description: Emoticons, now with extra Bow Meow!

name: Bow Wow Emoticons
description: They say a Bow Wow is an adventurer's best friend...

name: Bilby Emoticons
description: Be there, be square.

name: Al Howin Emoticons
description: For all your Drowsy Hollow cosplay needs.

name: Kongoku's Chest
description: The excess energy released by Kongoku made this chest appear.

name: Voldelor's Chest
description: This chest holds all of Enurado's missing gold.

name: Warrior of KOs' Chest
description: This massive chest holds extremely heavy and tough items.

name: Anatak's Chest
description: This chest appears where lightning strikes.

name: Zatoishwan's Chest
description: Only a very inebriated person can find this chest.

name: Emote Scroll: Ethyl
description: Use this scroll to learn the Pandawa class's special emote.

name: Fortifying Flesh Bullion
description: This bullion is not too hot, not too cold, not too spicy, and not enough. In fact, you feel like you're eating a cloud.

name: Emote Scroll: Elemental
description: Use this scroll to learn the Huppermage class's special emote.

name: Huppermage Rune
description: Diverse information about the Huppermages.

name: Bytbul Eidolonic Veil
description: Have you always dreamed of looking like a Bytbul? Now, with the power of dimensional technomagic, it's possible!

name: Sucatrose Eidolonic Veil
description: Have you always dreamed of looking like a Sucatrose? Now, with the power of dimensional technomagic, it's possible!

name: Jammy Jack Eidolonic Veil
description: Have you always dreamed of looking like a Jammy Jack? Now, with the power of dimensional technomagic, it's possible!

name: Annoyed Catichan Eidolonic Veil
description: Have you always dreamed of looking like an Annoyed Catichan? Now, with the power of dimensional technomagic, it's possible!

name: Emote Scroll: Duelist
description: Use this scroll to learn the Duelist emote.

name: Huppermage Elixir
description: A good slug of this and you'll be teleported to the Huppermage Temple. Known side effects: hiccups, apparition of in-laws, hair loss, dog breath, untied shoelaces, successive red traffic lights.

name: Joris Emoticons
description: Now your character can be every bit as expressive as Joris!

name: Snikandy
description: This candy, dedicated to the famed Sniikzy, won all the votes in a popularity contest.However, the crafting company of candies – sour, caustic, bitter, spicy, corrosive, burning, biting or sardonic (the famous SCBSCBBS) – is very attached to names which are easy to pronounce, and wanted to show their good taste by renaming it.

name: Emote Scroll: Deploy Bontarian Wings
description: Use this scroll to learn the Deploy Bontarian Wings emote.

name: Emote Scroll: Deploy Brakmarian Wings
description: Use this scroll to learn the Deploy Brakmarian Wings emote.

name: Atcham's Chest
description: This chest holds the loot from a thousand misdeeds.

name: Emote Scroll: Lucky
description: Use this scroll to learn the Ecaflip class's special emote.

name: Ecaflip Feed
description: After having tasted this delicious potted feed, you'll be making claw marks everywhere... for a while, at least.

name: Bloody
description: Use this scroll to learn the Sacrier class's special emote.

name: Gisgoul Potion
description: A smell of coagulated blood emanates from this potion, and consuming it will make you appear instantly in the Tower of Gisgoul.

name: Arachnee Elixir
description: By drinking this elixir in one gulp, you have a 50% chance of being transformed into an Arachnee. But you're best not finding out what happens when it doesn't work.

name: Astrub Kitchen Soup
description: This delicious, aromatic soup causes pestilential flatulence. It's not surprising that it's so popular in Astrub.

name: The Weight Escape
description: The events described in this book are refuted by the official authorities, which is probably the best guarantee of their truthfulness.

name: Araknas Chest
description: This chest doesn't contain the remains of the poor bugger who was liquefied by Arachnee venom, but the Araknas Sacred Stones User Guide. What are you waiting for to open it?

name: Regenerative
description: Use this scroll to learn the Eniripsa class's special emote.

name: Emote Scroll: Psychotic
description: Use this scroll to learn the Masqueraider class's special emote.

name: Sack of Mahaquany
description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Mahaquany.

description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Salikronia.

description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Quisnoa.

description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Limpet.

description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Sepiolite.

name: Rygurgal Certificate
description: This certificate awards you the title of "Koutoulou Fhtagn".

name: Tritun Certificate
description: This certificate awards you the title of "Tritunite".

name: Fair Beer
description: With its fruity and spicy aromas, this drink is ideal for living it up, but it can quickly lead to screwing it up when consumed excessively.

name: Animal
description: Use this scroll to learn the Osamodas class's special emote.

name: Elemental Soul Stone
description: This very peculiar soul stone is able to contain the Shadow Soul.

name: Indestructible
description: Use this scroll to learn the Feca class's special emote.

name: Iop Fatal Blow
description: Use this scroll to learn the god Iop's Fatal Blow.

name: Dusty Bottle
description: An old bottle of cola from the West Lighthouse.

name: Earthy Bottle
description: An old bottle of iced tea from the West Lighthouse.

description: Use this scroll to learn Goultard's Fatal Blow.

name: Otomai Fatal Blow
description: Use this scroll to learn Otomai's Fatal Blow.

name: Desert Beer
description: This beer won't quench your thirst, but it'll make your head spin and your tongue loose, which is much more important.

name: Castuc Beer
description: This is a drink which doesn't lack zest.

name: Emeritus Ally Certificate
description: This certificate awards you the title of "Emeritus Ally".

name: Ouginak's Rage
description: Diverse information about the Ouginaks.

name: Ouginak Elixir
description: A good slug of this and you'll be teleported to the Ouginak Temple. Known side effects: hiccups, apparition of in-laws, hair loss, dog breath, untied shoelaces, successive red traffic lights.

name: Rabid
description: Use this scroll to learn the Ouginak class's special emote.

description: Use this scroll to learn the Victorious Guild emote.

description: Use this scroll to learn the Dofus Cup emote.

description: This certificate awards you the title of "Winner of the Dofus Cup".

name: Gisgoul Beer
description: A light beer that does not cause a hanghoulver.

name: Sidimote Beer
description: Hic!

name: Erzal's Beverage
description: This beverage temporarily gives its drinker the physical features of a Chafer. The archbishop didn't manage to pour these monsters' perversity into it, which explains why alchemists aren't interested in it.

name: Edible Giant Mushroom
description: One bite of this giant mushroom will make you tiny.

name: Magmatic
description: Use this scroll to learn the Magmatic emote.

name: Gladiator
description: Use this scroll to learn the Gladiator emote.

name: Ice Knight's Chest
description: This chest was found frozen by its hidden contents.

name: Zombite
description: Use this scroll to learn the Zombite emote.
Use this scroll to learn this emote . . . . ..

name: Mini Slice of Happiness
description: When you eat this little slice of pie that's dripping with happiness, you'll temporarily take on the appearance of a Minikron. The effects will disappear as soon as you start a fight.

name: Warrior of Summer 647 Certificate
description: This certificate awards you the title of "Warrior of Summer 647".

name: Globally Pre-Sentient Potion for Mounts
description: This potion makes mounts Globally Pre-Sentient, giving them the ability to reach destinations shown to them automatically.

name: Ivory Certificate
description: This certificate awards you the title of "Of Ash and Ivory".

name: Miss/Mr World of Twelve 648 Certificate

name: Lemon Fortunawa Cookie
description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "A white Kwak on a lake is never fake!"

Eating this cookie will increase your Agility in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

name: Strawberry Fortunawa Cookie
description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "Balance is classy. The opposite isn't always true."

Eating this cookie will increase your Intelligence in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

name: Api Fortunawa Cookie
description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "Dofus plantus, nerfus sadidus." This cookie tastes like the fortune writer's tears.

Eating this cookie will increase your Strength in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

name: Plum Fortunawa Cookie
description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "Whoever dirties his quill, darkens his page."

Eating this cookie will increase your Chance in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

name: Strawberry-Lemon Fortunawaduo Cookie
description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "The hero reading this message is a Iop!" Finally, someone who appreciates you the way you deserve.

Eating this cookie will increase your Intelligence and Agility in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

name: Api-Strawberry Fortunawaduo Cookie
description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "This is not a proverb." The message leaves you feeling confused.

Eating this cookie will increase your Strength and Intelligence in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

name: Plum-Strawberry Fortunawaduo Cookie
description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "Fighting alongside a disciple of Iop teaches you bravery; fighting alongside a disciple of Sram teaches you solitude."

Eating this cookie will increase your Chance and Intelligence in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

name: Api-Lemon Fortunawaduo Cookie
description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "The Krosmoz contains a world that the world cannot understand."

Eating this cookie will increase your Strength and Agility in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

name: Api-Plum Fortunawaduo Cookie
description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "When shadows disappoint, light remembers." You get a feeling someone is trying to send you a message.

Eating this cookie will increase your Strength and Chance in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

name: Plum-Lemon Fortunawaduo Cookie
description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "For a Rogue, value comes from strategy, not courage."

Eating this cookie will increase your Chance and Agility in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.
