name: Umeshushu
description: Those are not actually eyeballs floating in the bottle; they're just apriplums. That means they're a lot less creepy than you thought and altogether a poor idea for an Al Howin accessory. But Umeshusu is delicious. Just take a sip and let yourself be carried away on fruit-filled waves of nectar to a land of unsuspected flavour.

name: Pandazahi
description: This dry beer is recommended by the Grandapan for unclogging the ears and thereby hearing the voice of the goddess better.

name: Pandaporo
description: If it's Pandaporo, pour me some more-o!

name: The Paths of Pandawushu
description: A summary of the major principles of Pandawushu.

name: Pandakwak
description: Nicknamed "bamber nectar", this speciality beer from the port of Osakwa is brewed from bamboo milk and seawater. This subtle and original brew is a radical cure for freshwater addiction.

name: Seasonal Warrior 650 Certificate
description: This certificate awards you the title of "Seasonal Warrior 650".

name: Spiritual Certificate
description: This certificate awards you the title of “Team Spirit".

name: Pandawushuka Apprentice Certificate
description: This certificate awards you the title of "Apprentice Pandawushuka".

name: Master of Martial Paths Certificate
description: This certificate awards you the title of "Master of Martial Paths".

name: Reinforced Soul Stone
description: Unique in its kind, this stone lets you capture the most recalcitrant souls.

name: 99% Alcohol
description: Drinking this alcohol neat is strongly discouraged.

name: Kronengob
description: This beer is so strong that it could kill any goblin that tries to swallow it. Only Leprechauns have any chance of surviving it... and they win every time. Lucky devils.

name: Flat Okirhym
description: Created by Carol Loois, rhymer extraordinaire, and perfected by Keg O'Beer, this beer is a favourite among poets and artists long on thirst and short on inspiration.

name: Shaké
description: Lighter than fermented bamboo milk, but just as treacherous.

name: High-Fermentation Shaké
description: A version of shaké with much higher alcohol content. Consume in moderation.

name: Betadjutant Certificate
description: This certificate awards you the title of "Betadjutant".

name: Swipolifis
description: "Swipe your troubles away on Nolifis with a tall Swipolifis."

name: One for the Road
description:
This drink – according to a persistent rumour – allows the dying to reach Externam without getting lost along the way. It's probably why alchemists use it when concocting a mysterious elixir...
If you've always dreamed of wandering like a wayward soul, downing this tankard will make your dream come true until your next fight.

name: Ferrier's Elixir
description:
Drinking the contents of this vial will stimulate your sixth sense; you'll be able to see the legendary Route of the Dead in Pandala.
(You need to be on Nolifis Island to use this potion.)

name: Yugo Fatal Blow
description: Use this scroll to learn Yugo's fatal blow.

name: Corsair Bag
description: This bag surely contains valuables.

name: Monkiki'ng Bag
description: This bag surely contains valuables.

name: Samurai
description: Use this scroll to learn the Samurai emote.

name: Limo d'Grobe
description: Who says that Pandawa taste buds can't appreciate non-alcoholic beverages? Sure, this fancy lemonade with a funny name is only popular among Pandawas who've taken up permanent residence on Nolifis Island. But dead or deader, they're still Pandawas.

name: Fermented Mimilk
description: Bow Meows have the right to drink alcoholic beverages, too!

name: Cania Bandits' Treasure Chest
description: This chest contains a few trinkets stolen by Nomekop, Edasse and Eratz. With a little luck, what you want will be inside.

name: Gnole de Grobe
description: Brewed on Nolifis Island, this top-fermented beer would get even the most tongue-tied spirit talking.

name: Virizeon's Breath
description: Use this scroll to learn the Virizeon's Breath emote.

name: Nyan Beer
description: This drink will make you purrrr!

name: Mam Pla Sauce
description:
This sauce is Niki Minawa's speciality. It achieves the incredible feat of making everything taste like Snapper.
If you drink it, you will start to look like a Kloon Snapper. Don't worry, the effect is not permanent and fades as soon as you start fighting.

name: Grand Puddah Beer
description: Now here's a drink that'll won't leave you as cold as marble... or will it?

name: Folded Words
description:
When you unfold these words, you will receive a paper haiku.
(Double-click to use.)

name: Blackened Words
description:
When you unfold these words, you will receive an ink haiku.
(Double-click to use.)

name: Harvested Words
description:
When you unfold these words, you will receive a haiku of the two kingdoms.
(Double-click to use.)

name: Obscure Words
description:
When you unfold these words, you will receive a Wukin haiku.
(Double-click to use.)

name: Enlightened Words
description:
When you unfold these words, you will receive a Wukang haiku.
(Double-click to use.)

name: The Tale of the Scholar and the Moumouse
description: This traditional Pandalan legend has been adapted into a theatre play. To watch a performance, head to the ink theatre in Akwadala.

name: Poet Certificate
description: This certificate awards you the title of "Soul of a Poet".

name: Pandako's Swane
description: This paper Swane won't grant all your wishes, but it will follow you wherever you go. However, it will fly away as soon as you start to fight... probably because it's a symbol of peace for all Pandalans.

name: Pizwa
description: Gluttony is bad! If you eat this pizwa, you may feel luckier at the end of your fights, but you will also feel much heavier – unless you are a true Ninjawa Turtle.

name: Wholewrite Bread
description: This bread made with unbleached and unrefined paper is much healthier for you than plain write bread.

name: Pumperinkel
description: The colour makes it look rather unappetising, but you will definitely gain some energy from eating this bread.

name: Celestial Candy
description: Words cannot describe the exquisite taste of this sweet.

name: Tsingtawo Beer
description: This beer has become hugely popular outside Pandala thanks to Pandawas who travel the world.

name: Bambooze
description: Fancy a sip of bamboo?

name: Light Strong Beer
description: Pandazahi improves hearing, but the light strong beer from the Forbidden Inn does much more: it gives your lugholes a deep cleaning. Much more effective than any cotton buds. It's even credited with making the ears of an unfortunate fan who attended a Pandalida concert grow back... Taste tested, approved and consumed by the Grandapan himself (in its most concentrated format).

name: Bag of Ink Snappers
description: This enormous bag contains an impressive quantity of Ink Snappers.

name: Bag of Bendable Crystals
description: This enormous bag contains an impressive quantity of bendable crystals.

name: Bag of Liquid Crystals
description: This enormous bag contains an impressive quantity of liquid crystals.

name: Bag of Paper Tulips
description: This enormous bag contains an impressive quantity of paper tulips.

name: Barroll Brewski
description: This beer will make you wobble like a rolling barrel.

name: Faded Leaves: An Anthology
description: In remembrance of a voyage in the land of words, as pages turn like fleeting blossoming seasons, a paper goblin awaits.

name: Words to Speak By
description: This book may well have been the first ever written by a Pandawa's hand... Or perhaps it's merely a dream whose pages you turn out of curiosity on dreamy nights only to forget what you've read when dawn breaks.

name: Fruit Juice
description: Boost your energy with this drink that contains no artificial colours or preservatives!

name: Sushiwi
description: This delicate slice of raw fish, perched on mound of rice from the paddy fields of Akwadala, simply melts in the mouth.

name: Makwi
description: Be careful when eating this makwi because it rolls off the tongue.

name: Confinuum Exodus Certificate
description: This certificate awards you the title of "Confinuum Exodus".

name: Ninjawa Beer
description: Drink this beer to become as agile as a Ninjawa Turtle. Which one can be a bit of a toss-up, though.

name: Okirhym
description: Created by Carol Loois, rhymer extraordinaire, and perfected by Keg O'Beer, this beer is a favourite among poets and artists long on thirst and short on inspiration.

name: Dimensional Black Pudding
description: Taking a bite of this piece of black pudding will give your dimensions a whole new dimension.

name: Warrior
description: Use this scroll to learn the Warrior emote.

name: Fallen from the Heavens
description: The legend of the creation of paper arts, or how one thousand swanes allowed a star to join the eternighty.

name: Guardian of the Arts Certificate

name: Pandamonium Beer
description: The biggest fans of this beer are very often not alone in their heads.

name: Pigzebub Beer
description: Available in classic, berry and raspberry versions, this beer will invigorate both the pig and the demon sleeping inside you.

name: Porkania Sausage
description:
Fat is life, and the fat inside this wild-tasting sausage might just change yours.
Oink?

name: Possessed Fatal Blow
description: Use this scroll to learn the Possessed Fatal Blow.

name: Globally Pre-Sentient Potion for Petsmounts
description: This potion makes a petsmount Globally Pre-Sentient, giving it the ability to reach a specified destination automatically.

name: Sex Change Potion
description: [!] Cette potion à boire directement au goulot vous permettra de devenir lui si vous étiez elle ou de devenir elle si vous étiez lui. À consommer sans modération.

name: Meteor
description: Use this scroll to learn the Meteor emote.

name: Victorus aut Mortis Diploma
description: This certificate awards you the title "Victorus aut Mortis".

name: Shushette
description:
When it's hotter than blazes, there's nothing like a long swig at 6.66° to wet your whistle! Stronger and redder than many ales, this Shuchuan pepper beer is loved by demons everywhere. Apparently, even Bontarians will shell their shouls – shorry, sell their souls – for a sip...
Consume with moderation if you don't want to find yourself looking at an exorcist through beer goggles, pickle your faith, or trigger the Eli-hiccup-alypse.

description: Use this scroll to learn the Rain Call emote.

name: Katiay Clan Standard
description: Use this scroll to learn the Katiay Clan Standard emote.

name: Legendary Whitebeerd Beer
description: Brewed by a Stubbyob from a vanished clan, this beer is probably among the rarest in the World of Twelve. Savour it as its unique status deserves, and enjoy the legendary hangover it's sure to leave you with.

name: Valiant Scrollsayer Certificate
description: This certificate awards you the title of "Valiant Scrollsayer".

name: Signed Bonta Gobbowl Ball
description: This ball made of pure gobball wool has been signed by the players on Bonta's official team. Just by touching it, you can imagine yourself on the field, being skilfully passed from hand to hand until you land behind the goal line... Of course, most normal people would imagine themselves as a player rather than the ball, but that's neither here nor there.

name: Signed Brakmar Gobbowl Ball
description: This ball made of pure gobball wool has been signed by the players on Brakmar's official team. Just by touching it, you can imagine yourself on the field, being skilfully passed from hand to hand until you're slammed down behind the goal line. Of course, most normal people would imagine themselves as a player rather than the ball, but that's neither here nor there.

name: Nutcracker Emote Potion
description:
For a few seconds, you'll finally deserve to be called a nutcracker.

Note: this is a single-use potion.

name: Brakmarian Nachos
description:
Support your favourite gobbowl team while enjoying these delicious nachos from the Black City.

Double-click to temporarily transform into a gobbowler.

name: Bontarian Popcorn
description:
Support your favourite gobbowl team while enjoying this delicious popcorn from the White City.

Double-click to temporarily transform into a gobbowler.

name: Memory of a Bontarian Soldier
description: When you fight for Bonta, death is only the first step in eternal glory. Honour this soldier's memory, and wear his armour with respect.

name: Memory of a Brakmarian Soldier
description: When you join the Brakmarian army, you're in it for life... and the afterlife too. Will you be able to brandish this soldier's pike as proudly and boldly as he did?

name: Memory of an Azure Warrior
description: The sacrifice made by the knights of the Valiant Heart has inspired generations of Bontarians. Many gifted swordsmen and talented swordswomen achieved illustrious feats as they drew their noble blades to defend their ideals. May they guide you to the light as well!

name: Memory of a Blood Warrior
description: The most important thing isn't to win, but to be a part of the action. Did Hyrkul and Djaul break down and cry after a setback? No, never! They pulled themselves up and kept fighting. Breaking bones, smashing skulls, and spilling the blood of one's enemies... An ideal worthy of the darkest of fates!

description: This set reflects your involvement in a life that goes beyond the ordinary. You've finally got your hands on it after many a twist and turn, making you one of a tiny minority to have accomplished this feat.

This delicious homemade pudding was made with love and a runny nose according to Old Man Dukrass's traditional recipie, with a few improvements by Chef Gobuchon.
To be eaten without moderation – especially if you want to look enough like Gobelishous to terrorise your pals and steal their snacks during recess.

name: Tehlaytubiez Corktail
description: Roll call done, and it's now obvious: one seems to be missing...

name: Daonlohdabl Corktail
description:
If you squint, you can just barely make out a tiny sentence engraved on the bottom of the glass:

"In order to enjoy the full range of flavours when consuming this beverage, make sure you've already applied the Lon Cheur update."

name: Tehlaython Corktail
description: Every year, all profits from the sale of this beverage are donated to the Twelvian Association for Rare Alteration Research.

name: Realetytivi Corktail
description: If you're seized with the desire to close your eyes between two sips, let yourself be carried away by the rustling of the wind in the palm trees. When you drift back to reality, you'll be surprised to see that you've traded your fingered hands for a pair of large, rounded pincers.

name: Tehlayskop Corktail
description: Be careful not to bump sharply into anything once you've drunk this corktail – you might just explode into a truly impressive amount of tiny, sharp pieces.

description: Made from honey collected in the Snowbound Timberland and spring water, distilled in huge vats in the basement of the Meadery, this beverage is a local speciality in Albuera.

name: 10 Expedition Badges
description: You've collected badges like this one in all your expeditions. A symbol of your boundless courage, you might be able to trade it for fabulous treasures.

name: Brewbittering Beer
description: Now there's no need to drink a glass of water between beverages when you're having a sesh. This beer, brewed with pure Ereboria water, won't give you a hangover. At least, that's what the Bitter-Hammers say; you're free to believe them or not.

name: Brumaire's Frost
description: Use this scroll to learn the Brumaire's Frost emote.

name: Forgelance Heritage
description: Provides various details about the Forgelances.

name: Forgelance Elixir
description: A good slug of this and you'll be teleported to the Forgelance Temple. Known side effects: hiccups, apparition of in-laws, hair loss, dog breath, untied shoelaces, successive red traffic lights.

description: This huge bag contains an impressive amount of ashenstone.

name: Seven Lances for One Destiny

description: The contents of this chest won't be a surprise for miners.

name: Mount Experience Potion
description: If you want your mount to have more experience without spending hours training it, this potion is for you.

name: La Tourmenteuze
description: Drowning your torments in alcohol is never the right solution, and even less so with this beer. On the other hand, if you just want to drink like a dark knight to terrify your friends, cheers!

name: Riktus Bockus
description: Whether swordfighter, enchantress, archer or seasoned fighter, always put on a toothy smile to maintain the maskarade!

name: Bworkenbräu
description: Sip this superior brew to calm down those bothersome brainwaves that occasionally tickle your neurons. You'll understand why beer is the only thing a Bwork will ever pause to think about.

name: Ice Storm Ale
description: Get a firm grip on your glass and don't let it slip. Spilling such a fine beer on the floor could cast quite a chill on your evening.

name: Pandissident Pint
description: At the end of a tough battle, there's nothing better than a cold pint of beer to celebrate your victory, forget your defeat, or just spill something other than blood for a change.

name: Dark Crafter's Cup
description: Work is health. So here's to yours! Any crafter will tell you that after a hard day of work, it's important to share a friendly moment together before divvying up the loot.

name: Skeleton Brew
description: Some killjoys will tell you that drinking beer weakens your bones. But the contents of this bottle will do just the opposite.

name: Hair of the Bow Wow
description: Some Ouginaks don't know whether to take the old saying about "the hair of the bow wow that bit you" literally or figuratively. So to be on the safe side, they treat their hangovers by drinking a pint for breakfast and biting each other's fur. Seems to work, though!

name: Zoth-n-Froth
description: One of z'ese pints z'not like z'others...

name: Big Chief's Beer Horn
description: It's said that the Manitou Zoth's horn of plenty never runs dry. Alas, the same can't be said for this one. His fate is one of abundance, and yours one of obedience. But maybe you can switch roles just this once...

name: Alliance Renaming Potion (Moderation)
description: Use this potion to rename an alliance.

name: Sidekick Ale
description: This beer can be enjoyed on your own in small sips, or drained in one go on a relaxing night out with your favourite drinking sidekicks.

name: Non-Alcoholic Half-Pint
description: Tastes great, less filling!

name: Olde Eggy
description: For once, a popular beer that actually is all it's cracked up to be.

name: Forgelance Heritage
description: Use this scroll to learn the Forgelance Heritage emote.

name: Gut Twister
description: Alcohol consumption can be dangerous for your health. Perfect. You love living dangerously!

name: Fewmented Cawwot Juice
description: How far would you go to get your five fruits and vegetables a day? Pop open this bottle if you dare! But we can't be held wesponsible fow the wesults.

name: Firefoux Ginger Beer
description: A lot of people imagine they're more attractive when they drink, but in this case it's actually true. Prepare to feel your fouxiest!

description: This certificate awards you the title of "Premium Manitum".

name: Side Dish
description: It's better to eat alone than with the wrong side(kick)... hence this dish.

name: Steak in Hunter's Sauce
description: A thick, savoury steak before heading out on the hunt to give the monsters a taste of your blade!

name: Class Change Potion (20)
description: You can use this potion to change class.

name: Ephedrya Haven Bag Popocket
description: Use this popocket to acquire the Ephedrya haven bag theme and all its decorative elements.

name: Stone Cold Lampin'
description: Best... enjoyed... ice... cold... and... very... very... slowly.

name: Blind Hammer Ale
description: Really hits the spot! Sometimes a little too hard...

name: Golden Regrets
description: Some drink to remember, some drink to forget.

name: Pili-Pilsi
description: Nicknamed Pili-Peepee by Kanniball children and goblins alike, this beer has a low alcohol content but a powerful taste that comes from the hot pepper lurking just below the foam. Lektor himself once famously remarked that a good pili-pilsi could really "tear your face off" and therefore bring back all kinds of great memories.

name: Midnight Mush
description: Despite its visual resemblance to mouldy soup, this foam-free beer is said to be an insomniac's best friend. Apparently, it has impressive spororific properties.

name: Sewer Brew
description: The taste of this brew is enough to make anyone vomit, but the smell is even worse. Best stored in a hermetically sealed vial, ideally far underground.

name: Weal Spawkling Lagew
description: Stubbyobs don't like that the thick foam gets stuck in their beards. Ah well, more for the rest of us!

name: Incarnated Class 653 Certificate
description: This certificate awards you the title of "Incarnated Class 653".

name: Miss/Mr World of Twelve 653 Certificate
description: This certificate awards you the title of "Miss (or Mr) World of Twelve 653".

name: Sylvaspirit Essence
description:
If you're not worried about being hunted by adventurers the next time you go for a walk in the Petrified Forest, go ahead and drink this potion.
Only those who have prayed in the deepest depths of the mystified temple are worthy of quenching their spiritual thirst.

name: Sour Idolised Pearldrop
description:
Rediscover the charm and flavour of bygone days with this traditionally made sugary pearldrop sweet.
(This sweet increases Wisdom by 100 points for 60 minutes.)

description:

name: Kwismas Beer
description: Nothing beats a nice tall glass of cold, sappy beer before heading out to fight multicoloured dragons in the pine forests.

name: Imp Fairywork
description: Storms don't always have to rage and blow until the winds crack their cheeks. They can also be a source of fun. Just ask any Imp! If you're into chasing thunderstorms, nothing beats a good fairy and a lightning spud!

name: Kolossium Potion
description: Use this potion to teleport to the Kolossium.

name: Nice Kwismas Gift Giveaway
description:
Opening this package will double your odds of getting nice gifts from fights in the Kwismas Haven region. This thrilling giveaway will last for one hour. It has no effect inside the Kwismas Dungeon.
(Double-click to use.)

name: Great Kwismas Gift Giveaway
description:
Opening this package will double your odds of getting great gifts from fights in the Kwismas Land region. This thrilling giveaway will last for one hour. It has no effect inside the Kwismas Cavern.
(Double-click to use.)

name: Wonderful Kwismas Gift Giveaway
description:
Opening this package will double your odds of getting wonderful gifts from fights in the Kwismas Taiga region. This thrilling giveaway will last for one hour. It has no effect inside Father Kwismas's House.

name: Insignificant Guss Chest
description: When you knock on the lid, it sounds empty, but maybe, just maybe, there's something interesting in here. A molar? Some hair? A hairy molar? The sky's the limit.

name: Rusty Guss Chest
description: Harder to open than to close, but easier to forget than to find.

name: Intriguing Guss Chest
description: It could contain anything and everything, but it's more likely to contain next to nothing.

name: Surprising Guss Chest
description: One thing's for sure: it contains a surprise. Good or bad, only time will tell.

name: Solid Guss Chest
description: This chest is solid enough to be thrown at the head of the person who gave it to you if you don't like what's inside. Bear that in mind.

name: Heavy Guss Chest
description: You'll be light-headed with joy when you reveal the contents of this heavy chest.

name: Sparkling Guss Chest
description: If you hit two sparkling chests together hard enough, you just might produce some sparks and start a fire to burn their disappointing contents and quell your rage.

name: Imposing Guss Chest
description: Even if you never manage to open it, this chest makes you look like a genuine treasure hunter.

name: Impressive Guss Chest
description: If you hide inside this chest, even you can be impressive!

name: Superior Guss Chest
description: This chest is enormous... but not enormous enough to file away all the archives on your superiority complex.

name: Simple Ephemeral Brett Tattoo
description:
Brett was a swordsman with a fearsome reputation throughout the Cania Plains. He attacked any travellers who crossed his path, supposedly to show them his talent with a blade. It's said that he eventually slew himself in a burst of excessive enthusiasm.
This tattoo will lend you a tiny fraction of Brett's power.

name: Simple Ephemeral Tankhor Tattoo
description:
Captain Tankhor was a force of nature, a colossal man overflowing with vitality. His ship seemed to be everywhere at once, from the Antinau Sea to the Asse Sea, from Cania Bay to the coast of the Stontusk Desert. His swashbuckling career ended in tragedy, with a sad tale of an anchor, a giant kralove and countless gallons of ink.
This tattoo will lend you a tiny fraction of Tankhor's vitality.

name: Simple Ephemeral Looth Tattoo
description:
Looth was unmatched when it came to methodically exploring a location or searching a defeated enemy's body to steal their meagre possessions. Rejecting attachments to any clan or gang like the Cania Ruffians, she was driven solely by raw profit motive. She died the way she lived: fast and with terrifying violence.
This tattoo will lend you a tiny fraction of Looth's prospecting talents.

name: Gladiatrool Tamer Certificate
description: This certificate awards you the title of "Gladiatrool Tamer".

name: Gladiatrool Acrobat Certificate
description: This certificate awards you the title of "Gladiatrool Acrobat".

name: Gladiatrool Magician Certificate
description: This certificate awards you the title of "Gladiatrool Magician".

name: Universal Pouch of 10 Loyalokens
description: Loyalokens reward the loyal, whether from this world or another.

name: Stoolouflage Mimagic Potion
description: Drink this potion to rest on a solid foundation and turn yourself into a stool.

name: Barrouflage Mimagic Potion
description: Drink this potion to barrelcade yourself and turn yourself into a barrel.

name: Trashouflage Mimagic Potion
description: Drink this potion to tidy up and turn yourself into a trash bin.

name: Trool Croozer Mimagic Potion
description: Drink this potion to celebrate your victories in the Gladiatrool and transform yourself into a Trool Croozer. That way you'll be a bit more cracked.

name: Artrooleryman Mimagic Potion
description: Drink this potion to celebrate your victories in the Gladiatrool and transform yourself into an Artrooleryman: everyone who tugs their rubbers will appreciate it.

name: Nitrool Mimagic Potion
description: Drink this potion to celebrate your victories in the Gladiatrool and transform yourself into a Nitrool. Even if you've only won tokens, you've well earned your wage of fear.

name: Toffee Api
description: Eating this caramelised api could turn you as red as a tomato. How can that be? The magic of Saint Ballotwine surely has something to do with it.

name: Sugared Quaquack
description: Thanks to this delicious treat, you won't have any more problems with your teeth. And to think some pessimists claim that too much sugar isn't good for your health. That's quackers!

description: This certificate awards you the title of "Gladiator".

description: This little bundle has lovable creatures in it.

description: Unlike Mastoslob, this chest won't eat your loot.

name: Mister Penguin's Chest
description: Unfortunately, this chest does not contain all of Mister Penguin's riches.

name: Katigger's Chest
description: This chest doesn't seem to have its fangs out for you.

description: This chest may disappear if you turn your back on it.

description: This chest contains the secret for getting your revenge.

description: This chest isn't as abominable as the YeCh'Ti, but it sure smells like it.

description: This chest contains one of Fuji Snowfoux's most precious assets.

description: Everyone who's tried to open this chest has found it a shocking experience.

name: Erotegg's Chest
description: Despite what you may have hoped, there are no eggs in this chest.

name: Bearendizer's Chest
description: You notice a few bees emerging from this chest.

name: Mekstagob's Chest
description: The mechanism to open this chest is almost as complicated as Mekstagob.

name: Psychopump's Chest
description: You may need a hand to get this chest open.

name: Archaeologist Chest

description:
Obtained from a bounty hunter, this box contains one or more map fragments.
(The fragments will be linked to the account.)

name: Guss Chest
description: This chest probably only contains a bunch of musty old junk.

name: Milivar Chest
description: You've certainly merited this award.

name: Scheik Chest
description: You found the time to waste some time to find a lost chest. There's something paradoxical about it all...

name: Sad Chest

name: Superb Ephemeral Tankhor Tattoo
description:
Captain Tankhor was a force of nature, a colossal man overflowing with vitality. His ship seemed to be everywhere at once, from the Antinau Sea to the Asse Sea, from Cania Bay to the coast of the Stontusk Desert. His swashbuckling career ended in tragedy, with a sad tale of an anchor, a giant kralove and countless gallons of ink.
This tattoo will lend you a tiny fraction of Tankhor's vitality.

name: Superb Ephemeral Looth Tattoo
description:
Looth was unmatched when it came to methodically exploring a location or searching a defeated enemy's body to steal their meagre possessions. Rejecting attachments to any clan or gang like the Cania Ruffians, she was driven solely by raw profit motive. She died the way she lived: fast and with terrifying violence.
This tattoo will lend you a tiny fraction of Looth's prospecting talents.

name: Superb Ephemeral Brett Tattoo
description:
Brett was a swordsman with a fearsome reputation throughout the Cania Plains. He attacked any travellers who crossed his path, supposedly to show them his talent with a blade. It's said that he eventually slew himself in a burst of excessive enthusiasm.
This tattoo will lend you a tiny fraction of Brett's power.
